inventory.detail.title: 库存与目标明细分页
inventory.detail.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

:gea_p1 AND (t.inventory_version = :gea_p2 OR (:gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND t.inventory_version = '月初')) GROUP BY t.year_month, t.inventory_version, t.belong_base, t.material_code), stock_source AS (SELECT WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.next_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS next_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.next_month_sales_plan) ELSE NULL END AS next_month_sales_plan, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d AS t WHERE t.data_month = CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND t.the_date = :gea_p3 GROUP BY t.data_month, t.the_date, t.belong_base, t.material_code), target_keys AS WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.current_inventory ELSE c.current_inventory END AS current_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.turnover_inventory IS NULL OR c.turnover_inventory <= 0))) AND m.turnover_inventory > 0 THEN m.turnover_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.turnover_inventory ELSE c.turnover_inventory END AS turnover_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.safety_stock IS NULL OR c.safety_stock <= 0))) AND m.safety_stock > 0 THEN m.safety_stock c.avg_daily_planned_demand END AS avg_daily_planned_demand, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.target_inventory IS NULL OR c.target_inventory <= 0))) IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.management_target_inventory IS NULL OR c.management_target_inventory <= 0))) AND m.management_target_inventory > 0 THEN m.management_target_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.management_target_inventory ELSE c.management_target_inventory END AS management_target_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.final_target_inventory IS NULL OR c.final_target_inventory <= 0))) AND m.final_target_inventory > 0 THEN m.final_target_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.final_target_inventory ELSE c.final_target_inventory END AS final_target_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.current_turnover_days IS NULL OR c.current_turnover_days <= 0))) AND m.current_turnover_days > 0 THEN m.current_turnover_days WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.current_turnover_days ELSE c.current_turnover_days END AS current_turnover_days, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.target_fill_rate IS NULL OR c.target_fill_rate <= 0))) AND m.target_fill_rate > 0 THEN AS avg_30d_sale, CASE WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.source_rows ELSE c.source_rows END AS target_rows FROM target_keys AS k LEFT JOIN target_source AS c ON c.belong_base = k.base AND c.material_code = k.sku AND c.inventory_version = :gea_p2 LEFT JOIN target_source AS m ON m.belong_base = k.base AND m.material_code = k.sku AND m.inventory_version = '月初' AND :gea_p2 = '纠偏'), inventory_keys AS (SELECT t.base AS base, t.sku AS sku FROM targets AS t UNION ALL SELECT s.belong_base AS base, s.material_code AS sku FROM stock_source AS s LEFT JOIN targets AS t ON t.base = s.belong_base AND t.sku = s.material_code WHERE t.sku IS NULL), aligned AS (SELECT k.base AS base, k.sku AS sku, :gea_p1 AS month, :gea_p3 AS stock_date, t.effective_version AS effective_version, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(s.material_name, t.material_name)), ''), pm.material_name) AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, ''), d.category) AS category, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.product_item, ''), d.item) AS item, s.series AS series, s.channel_name AS channel, t.product_tag AS product_tag, s.current_stock AS inventory, s.available_stock AS available, s.current_stock_60 AS over60, t.avg_daily_planned_demand AS daily_demand, t.safety_stock AS safety_stock, t.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, t.target_inventory AS initial_target, t.management_target_inventory AS management_target, t.final_target_inventory AS final_target, CASE WHEN t.sku IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.product_categ_name = '粽子' OR t.product_tag LIKE '%粽子%' OR t.material_name LIKE '%粽子%' THEN CASE WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand > 0 THEN t.turnover_inventory ELSE 0 END ELSE t.final_target_inventory END AS target, t.avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, s.avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, s.allocated_qty AS allocated, s.ordered_qty AS ordered, COALESCE(t.target_rows, 0) AS target_source_rows, COALESCE(s.source_rows, 0) AS stock_source_rows FROM inventory_keys AS k LEFT JOIN targets AS t ON t.base = k.base AND t.sku = k.sku LEFT JOIN stock_source AS s ON s.belong_base = k.base AND s.material_code = k.sku LEFT JOIN material_dictionary AS d ON d.sku = k.sku LEFT JOIN product_list_dictionary AS pm ON pm.sku = k.sku), business_rows AS (SELECT a.base AS base, a.sku AS sku, a.month AS month, a.stock_date AS stock_date, a.effective_version AS effective_version, a.material_name AS material_name, a.category AS category, a.item AS item, a.series AS series, a.channel AS channel, a.product_tag AS product_tag, a.inventory AS inventory, a.available AS available, a.over60 AS over60, a.daily_demand AS daily_demand, a.safety_stock AS safety_stock, a.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, a.initial_target AS initial_target, a.management_target AS management_target, a.final_target AS final_target, a.target AS target, a.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, a.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, a.allocated AS allocated, a.ordered AS ordered, a.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, a.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, a.inventory - a.target AS gap, CASE WHEN a.inventory IS NULL OR a.target IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN a.inventory < a.target THEN 'low' WHEN a.inventory > a.target THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END AS risk FROM aligned AS a), filtered AS (SELECT r.base AS base, r.sku AS sku, r.month AS month, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.effective_version AS effective_version, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.item AS item, r.series AS series, r.channel AS channel, r.product_tag AS product_tag, r.inventory AS inventory, r.available AS available, r.over60 AS over60, r.daily_demand AS daily_demand, r.safety_stock AS safety_stock, r.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, r.initial_target AS initial_target, r.management_target AS management_target, r.final_target AS final_target, r.target AS target, r.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, r.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, r.allocated AS allocated, r.ordered AS ordered, r.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, r.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, r.gap AS gap, r.risk AS risk FROM business_rows AS r WHERE (:gea_p4 = FALSE OR r.base IN (:gea_p5)) AND (:gea_p6 = 'all' OR (:gea_p6 = 'equal' AND r.sku = :gea_p7) OR (:gea_p6 = 'missing' AND r.sku IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p8 = 'all' OR (:gea_p8 = 'equal' AND r.category = :gea_p9) OR (:gea_p8 = 'missing' AND r.category IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p10 = 'all' OR (:gea_p10 = 'equal' AND r.item = :gea_p11) OR (:gea_p10 = 'missing' AND r.item IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p12 = 'all' OR (:gea_p12 = 'equal' AND r.series = :gea_p13) OR (:gea_p12 = 'missing' AND r.series IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p14 = 'all' OR (:gea_p14 = 'equal' AND r.channel = :gea_p15) OR (:gea_p14 = 'missing' AND r.channel IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p16 = 'all' OR (:gea_p16 = 'equal' AND r.risk = :gea_p17) OR (:gea_p16 = 'missing' AND r.risk IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p18 IS NULL OR LOWER(r.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.category) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18)) AND (:gea_p19 IS NULL OR r.category IS NULL OR r.category <> :gea_p19)) SELECT r.base AS base, r.sku AS sku, r.month AS month, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.effective_version AS effective_version, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.item AS item, r.series AS series, r.channel AS channel, r.product_tag AS product_tag, r.inventory AS inventory, r.available AS available, r.over60 AS over60, r.daily_demand AS daily_demand, r.safety_stock AS safety_stock, r.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, r.initial_target AS initial_target, r.management_target AS management_target, r.final_target AS final_target, r.target AS target, r.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, r.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, r.allocated AS allocated, r.ordered AS ordered, r.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, r.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, r.gap AS gap, r.risk AS risk FROM filtered AS r ORDER BY CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND r.gap IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.gap ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.gap ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND r.inventory IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.inventory ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.inventory ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND r.target IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.target ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.target ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND r.safety_stock IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.safety_stock ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.safety_stock ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND r.turnover_inventory IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.turnover_inventory ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.turnover_inventory ELSE NULL END DESC, r.base ASC, r.sku ASC LIMIT :gea_p20 OFFSET :gea_p21

inventory.summary.title: 库存与目标全范围汇总
inventory.summary.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。 汇总不受列表分页参数影响。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

inventory.options_count.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。

health.detail.notes: 按统计日、仓库编码、SKU读取；相同重复值只取一次，冲突保持未知。age_days是最大库龄。名称优先取库存快照商品名，源缺值时沿用原唯一SKU字典补充。名称均为当前参考，不回溯历史命名；左连接不改变库存行数。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')

 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base), '')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,

material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi AS t WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY t.material_code), business_rows AS (SELECT t.stat_date AS stat_date, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.belong_base) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.belong_base) = 1 THEN MAX(t.belong_base) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.warehouse_type) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.warehouse_type) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_type) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_type, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.product_categ_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_categ_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.material_group_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.material_group_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN t.current_stock) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_stock) ELSE NULL END AS current_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.safe_stock_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.safe_stock_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.safe_stock_qty) ELSE NULL END AS safe_stock_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.target_stock_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.target_stock_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.target_stock_qty) ELSE NULL END AS target_stock_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.age_days) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.age_days) = 1 THEN MAX(t.age_days) ELSE NULL END AS age_days, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.available_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.available_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.available_qty) ELSE NULL END AS available_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.pack_unit_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.pack_unit_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.pack_unit_qty) ELSE NULL END AS pack_unit_qty, CASE NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_source AS t WHERE t.stat_date = CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) GROUP BY t.stat_date, t.warehouseid, t.material_code), filtered AS (SELECT r.stat_date AS stat_date, r.belong_base AS belong_base, r.warehouse_type AS warehouse_type, r.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, r.material_group_name AS material_group_name, r.material_code AS material_code, r.is_overaged AS is_overaged, r.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, r.total_qty AS total_qty, health.count.title: 源库存健康度筛选后总数
health.count.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

health.summary.title: 源库存健康度全范围汇总
health.summary.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

health.groups.title: 源库存健康度分层汇总分页
health.groups.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

request.sql:
WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.belong_base AS belong_base, d.material_name AS material_name,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), inventory_batch_totals AS (
SELECT CAST(CONCAT(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2)) AS DATE) AS stat_date,
 a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base), '')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,

 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty, 0)) AS total_qty,

 SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty, 0)) AS pack_unit_qty,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty, 0)) AS freeze_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS age_days,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS overaged_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty
FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a
GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code

), inventory_batch_source AS (

health.options_count.title: 源库存健康度筛选选项数
health.options_count.notes: 按统计日/基地/仓库类型/仓库编码/SKU读取；同键重复保留NULL。total_qty用于仓库库存范围；current_stock、target_stock_qty为跨仓重复的基地SKU参考值，不逐仓相加。货龄采用同记录total_qty加权，不推演批次。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,

health.detail.atomic.title: 源库存健康度明细分页
health.detail.atomic.notes: 同一SQL读取总数及当前页；空页用一条标记行保留总数；外层显式保持原排序，不下载全量明细。；商品资料仅按唯一SKU匹配产品清单补空名称/物料组；同SKU字段冲突保留空，数量与日期范围不变。 批次现库存按仓库/SKU求和；不按 warehouse_classify 过滤或归类；分仓用 warehouseid 编码关联和筛选、warehouse_name 展示名称；基地用 belong_base 名称关联和筛选；商品名称取 material_name；基地与分仓为同一事实集的维度，不重复相加；正库存且生产日期有效的批次计算最大货龄。按原分仓规则逐批次汇总60天及以上超龄库存、90天及以上滞库库存；非正库存或无有效货龄的批次数量不计入风险量。安全/目标库存及更新时间仍保持未知。

WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.belong_base AS belong_base, d.material_name AS material_name,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), inventory_batch_totals AS (

request.sql: WITH fc_branch_scope AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouse_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid), '') IS NULL GROUP BY b.warehouseid), latest_inventory AS (SELECT MAX(agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d WHERE agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), warehouse_points AS (SELECT agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) END AS pickup_point FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d GROUP BY agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid), inventory_rows AS (SELECT i.month_date AS month_date, i.warehouseid AS warehouseid, i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, i.belong_base AS belong_base, i.material_code AS material_code, i.material_name AS material_name, i.prod_date AS prod_date, i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid, i.plant AS plant, i.quality_batch AS quality_batch, i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod, i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, i.available_qty AS available_qty, w.pickup_point AS pickup_point, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s ON i.month_date = s.month_date LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), point_location_candidates AS (SELECT inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type, inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code, MAX(inventory_rows.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(inventory_rows.belong_base) AS belong_base, CASE WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(inventory_rows.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid, COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.location_name) AS name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.belong_base) AS base_count FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows WHERE NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY inventory_rows.pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type, inventory_rows.location_code), point_locations AS (SELECT point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_code) AS location_code, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(point_location_candidates.belong_base) AS belong_base, MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates GROUP BY point_location_candidates.pickup_point HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1), current_order_lines AS (SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.cust_code AS cust_code, o.material_code AS material_code, o.material_name AS material_name, o.pickup_point AS pickup_point, o.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name, o.belong_base AS belong_base, o.qtyordered AS demand_qty, o.qtyallocated AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty < o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o WHERE o.detailstatus = 10 AND o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波', '组波中', '组波完成', '组波失败', '提交成功', '提交中', '提交失败', '上传验证', '人工释放占用', '撤回待改单', '创建') AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL), current_open_orders AS (SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code, l.pickup_point AS pickup_point FROM current_order_lines AS l GROUP BY l.cust_order_no, l.cust_code, l.pickup_point HAVING MAX(l.unshipped) = 1), current_open_lines AS (SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code, l.material_code AS material_code, l.material_name AS material_name, l.pickup_point AS pickup_point, l.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name, l.belong_base AS belong_base, l.demand_qty AS demand_qty, l.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty FROM current_order_lines AS l INNER JOIN current_open_orders AS o ON l.cust_order_no = o.cust_order_no AND (l.cust_code = o.cust_code OR (l.cust_code IS NULL AND o.cust_code IS NULL)) AND (l.pickup_point = o.pickup_point OR (l.pickup_point IS NULL AND o.pickup_point IS NULL))), eligible_order_sku AS (SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END AS location_type, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL')) ELSE m.location_code END AS location_code, MAX(COALESCE(m.location_name, o.pickup_point_name)) AS location_name, MAX(COALESCE(m.belong_base, o.belong_base)) AS belong_base, MAX(m.warehouseid) AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.demand_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.allocated_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) <> COUNT(*) OR COUNT(o.allocated_qty) <> COUNT(*) OR MIN(o.demand_qty) < 0 OR MIN(o.allocated_qty) < 0 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty) > 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty) ELSE 0 END AS remaining_qty, COUNT(*) AS source_row_count, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL OR o.demand_qty IS NULL OR o.allocated_qty IS NULL OR o.demand_qty < 0 OR o.allocated_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS input_invalid FROM current_open_lines AS o LEFT JOIN point_locations AS m ON o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point WHERE (NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL) GROUP BY o.cust_order_no, o.cust_code, o.material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL')) ELSE m.location_code END), fc_order_keys AS (SELECT o.location_type AS location_type, o.warehouseid AS warehouseid, o.material_code AS material_code FROM eligible_order_sku AS o GROUP BY o.location_type, o.warehouseid, o.material_code), source_records AS (SELECT t.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_future30_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_future30_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_transfer_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_transfer_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_onway_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_onway_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_prepare_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_prepare_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.stat_month) ELSE NULL END AS stat_month, '分仓同步表' AS plan_source, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS warehouse_month_transfer_plan, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.last_month_actual_qty) ELSE NULL END AS last_month_actual_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_day_avg_qty) ELSE NULL END AS current_day_avg_qty FROM agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS t WHERE t.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', ''), 1, 6) GROUP BY t.warehouse_code, t.material_code), branch_stock_keys AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') GROUP BY b.warehouseid, b.material_code), source_keys AS (SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.material_code AS material_code FROM source_records AS s UNION ALL SELECT h.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, h.material_code AS material_code FROM branch_stock_keys AS h WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, co.material_code AS material_code FROM fc_order_keys AS co WHERE co.location_type = '分仓' AND NOT co.material_code IS NULL AND NOT co.warehouseid IS NULL), scope_keys AS (SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, k.material_code AS material_code FROM source_keys AS k JOIN fc_branch_scope AS bs ON bs.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code GROUP BY k.warehouse_code, k.material_code), inventory_batch_dates AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code, b.month_date AS month_date, b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.material_name AS material_name, b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty, b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INT) AS snapshot_year, CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INT) AS snapshot_month, CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INT) AS snapshot_day, CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 1, 4) AS INT) AS production_year, CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 6, 2) AS INT) AS production_month, CAST(SUBSTRING(NULLIF(b.prod_date, ''), 9, 2) AS INT) AS production_day FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')), inventory_batch_ages AS (SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code, d.month_date AS month_date, d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.material_name AS material_name, d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty, d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d), inventory_batch_totals AS (SELECT CAST(CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2), '')) AS DATE) AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(COALESCE(a.live_qty, 0)) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS total_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0)) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty, 0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty, 0)) AS freeze_qty, MAX(a.age_days) AS age_days FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code), inventory_batch_names AS (SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid, n.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.material_group_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.material_group_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n GROUP BY n.warehouseid, n.material_code), inventory_batch_source AS (SELECT a.stat_date AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, COALESCE(a.warehouse_name, a.warehouseid) AS warehouse_name, a.material_name AS material_name, n.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, n.material_group_name AS material_group_name, a.total_qty AS total_qty, a.available_qty AS available_qty, a.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, a.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, a.age_days AS age_days FROM inventory_batch_totals AS a LEFT JOIN inventory_batch_names AS n ON n.warehouseid = a.warehouseid AND n.material_code = a.material_code), branch_stock AS (SELECT t.stat_date AS stat_date, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.product_categ_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_categ_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.material_group_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.material_group_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.total_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.total_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.total_qty) ELSE NULL END AS total_qty, t.warehouseid AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.warehouse_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.warehouse_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.age_days) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.age_days) = 1 THEN MAX(t.age_days) ELSE NULL END AS age_days, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.available_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.available_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.available_qty) ELSE NULL END AS available_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.pack_unit_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.pack_unit_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.pack_unit_qty) ELSE NULL END AS pack_unit_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.freeze_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.freeze_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.freeze_qty) ELSE NULL END AS freeze_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_source AS t WHERE t.stat_date = CAST(:gea_p2200 AS DATE) GROUP BY t.stat_date, t.warehouseid, t.material_code), branch_shipments AS (SELECT t.warehouse AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.material_group_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.material_group_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date >= :gea_p2002 AND t.act_dl_qty > 0 THEN t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END) AS month_ship_positive, SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date >= :gea_p2002 THEN COALESCE(t.act_dl_qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS month_ship_net, SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date >= :gea_p2003 AND t.act_dl_qty > 0 THEN t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END) AS rolling_ship_positive, MAX(t.act_ship_date) AS last_ship_date, COUNT(*) AS ship_source_rows FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS t WHERE t.warehouse_classify = '20' AND t.act_ship_date >= :gea_p2000 AND t.act_ship_date < :gea_p2001 GROUP BY t.warehouse, t.material_code), flow_names AS (SELECT t.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_group_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_group_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS t GROUP BY t.warehouseid, t.material_code), product_list_dictionary AS (SELECT t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi AS t WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY t.material_code), combined AS (SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, k.material_code AS sku, COALESCE(h.warehouse_name, s.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(h.material_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(s.material_name), ''), sh.material_name, n.material_name)), ''), pm.material_name) AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.product_categ_name), ''), h.product_categ_name, sh.category) AS category, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(sh.material_group, n.material_group, h.material_group_name)), ''), pm.material_group) AS material_group, h.total_qty AS inventory_qty, h.available_qty AS available_qty, COALESCE(h.pack_unit_qty, 0) AS occupied_qty, COALESCE(h.freeze_qty, 0) AS frozen_qty, h.age_days AS max_age, h.stat_date AS stock_date, CASE WHEN h.warehouseid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS stock_present, CASE WHEN s.source_rows IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS plan_present, COALESCE(s.source_rows, 0) AS source_rows, CASE WHEN s.transfer_prepare_qty IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS preparing_present, CASE WHEN s.transfer_onway_qty IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS in_transit_present, s.warehouse_month_out_plan AS month_out_plan, s.warehouse_future30_qty AS future30_qty, CASE WHEN s.warehouse_transfer_qty >= 0 THEN s.warehouse_transfer_qty WHEN s.warehouse_transfer_qty IS NULL AND s.transfer_onway_qty >= 0 AND s.transfer_prepare_qty >= 0 THEN s.transfer_onway_qty + s.transfer_prepare_qty ELSE NULL END AS open_transfer_reported_qty, COALESCE(s.transfer_onway_qty, 0) AS in_transit, COALESCE(s.transfer_prepare_qty, 0) AS preparing, s.stat_month AS stat_month, s.plan_source AS plan_source, s.warehouse_month_transfer_plan AS warehouse_month_transfer_plan, COALESCE(sh.month_ship_positive, 0) AS month_ship_positive, COALESCE(sh.month_ship_net, 0) AS month_ship_net, COALESCE(sh.rolling_ship_positive, 0) AS rolling_ship_positive, COALESCE(sh.rolling_ship_positive, 0) / 30.0 AS rolling_ship_daily, sh.last_ship_date AS last_ship_date, COALESCE(sh.ship_source_rows, 0) AS ship_source_rows, CASE WHEN s.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', ''), 1, 6) AND s.source_rows = 1 AND s.warehouse_month_out_plan >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS plan_calculable, s.last_month_actual_qty AS last_month_actual_qty, s.current_day_avg_qty AS current_day_avg_qty FROM scope_keys AS k LEFT JOIN source_records AS s ON (s.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code OR (s.warehouse_code IS NULL AND k.warehouse_code IS NULL)) AND (s.material_code = k.material_code OR (s.material_code IS NULL AND k.material_code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN branch_stock AS h ON h.warehouseid = k.warehouse_code AND h.material_code = k.material_code AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL LEFT JOIN branch_shipments AS sh ON sh.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code AND sh.sku = k.material_code LEFT JOIN flow_names AS n ON n.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code AND n.material_code = k.material_code LEFT JOIN product_list_dictionary AS pm ON pm.sku = k.material_code), location_sku_demand AS (SELECT eligible_order_sku.location_type AS location_type, eligible_order_sku.location_code AS location_code, eligible_order_sku.material_code AS material_code, MAX(eligible_order_sku.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(eligible_order_sku.belong_base) AS belong_base, MAX(eligible_order_sku.warehouseid) AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT eligible_order_sku.material_name) = 1 THEN MAX(eligible_order_sku.material_name) END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) END AS remaining_qty, SUM(eligible_order_sku.source_row_count) AS source_row_count, COUNT(*) AS order_sku_count, MAX(eligible_order_sku.input_invalid) AS historical_turnover_days, r.planned_daily_shipment AS planned_daily_shipment, r.remaining_outbound_qty AS remaining_outbound_qty, r.calculation_daily AS calculation_daily, r.forecast_turnover_days AS forecast_turnover_days, r.target_gap_qty AS target_gap_qty, r.safety_days AS safety_days, pp.current_out AS period_current_out, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS period_current_transfer, pp.next_out AS period_next_out, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS period_next_transfer, pp.current_source AS period_current_source, pp.next_source AS period_next_source, CASE WHEN pp.current_count > 1 THEN '同月计划冲突' WHEN pp.current_count = 1 AND pp.current_out >= 0 THEN '出货计划已同步；月调拨计划待接入' WHEN pp.current_count = 1 THEN '出货计划数量缺失或无效' ELSE '所选月份无出货计划' END AS period_plan_status, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.demand_qty, 0) END AS current_order_demand, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.allocated_qty, 0) END AS current_order_allocated, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.remaining_qty, 0) END AS current_order_remaining, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.shortage_qty, 0) END AS current_order_shortage, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS expected_month_end_qty, CASE WHEN pp.current_count <> 1 OR pp.current_out IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN pp.current_out - r.month_ship_positive > 0 THEN pp.current_out - r.month_ship_positive ELSE 0 END AS period_remaining_out, CASE WHEN pp.current_count = 1 AND pp.current_out >= 0 THEN CEIL(pp.current_out / CAST(:gea_p2301 AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END AS period_current_daily, CASE WHEN pp.next_count = 1 AND pp.next_out >= 0 THEN CEIL(pp.next_out / CAST(:gea_p2702 AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END AS period_next_daily, r.calculation_order_remaining AS calculation_order_remaining FROM filtered AS r LEFT JOIN fc_period_plans AS pp ON pp.warehouse_code = r.warehouse_code AND pp.sku = r.sku LEFT JOIN fc_current_orders AS co ON co.location_type = '分仓' AND co.warehouseid = r.warehouse_code AND co.material_code = r.sku CROSS JOIN fc_order_presence AS op ORDER BY r.warehouse_code, r.sku LIMIT :gea_p8 OFFSET :gea_p9

replenishment.count.title: 分仓补货完整范围计数
replenishment.count.notes: 仅取所选库存快照中20类分仓编码，计划/库存/订单均按该编码范围；有效未备单且未发货完成订单取qtyordered/qtyallocated件，排除作废、取消和关闭；已知建议与缺失计算行分别统计，未知不当0。

gea_p7.name: search_pattern
gea_p7.format: LIKE pattern; host escapes literal %/_/backslash and surrounds with % for literal contains

request.sql: WITH fc_branch_scope AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouse_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid), '') IS NULL GROUP BY b.warehouseid), latest_inventory AS (SELECT MAX(agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d WHERE agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), warehouse_points AS (SELECT agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) END AS pickup_point FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d GROUP BY agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid), inventory_rows AS (SELECT i.month_date AS month_date, i.warehouseid AS warehouseid, i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, i.belong_base AS belong_base, i.material_code AS material_code, i.material_name AS material_name, i.prod_date AS prod_date, i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid, i.plant AS plant, i.quality_batch AS quality_batch, i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod, i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, i.available_qty AS available_qty, w.pickup_point AS pickup_point, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s ON i.month_date = s.month_date LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), point_location_candidates AS (SELECT inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type, inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code, MAX(inventory_rows.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(inventory_rows.belong_base) AS belong_base, CASE WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(inventory_rows.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid, COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.location_name) AS name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.belong_base) AS base_count FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows WHERE NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY inventory_rows.pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type, inventory_rows.location_code), point_locations AS (SELECT point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_code) AS location_code, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(point_location_candidates.belong_base) AS belong_base, MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates GROUP BY point_location_candidates.pickup_point HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1), current_order_lines AS (SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.cust_code AS cust_code, o.material_code AS material_code, o.material_name AS material_name, o.pickup_point AS pickup_point, o.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name, o.belong_base AS belong_base, o.qtyordered AS demand_qty, o.qtyallocated AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty < o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o WHERE o.detailstatus = 10 AND o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波', '组波中', '组波完成', '组波失败', '提交成功', '提交中', '提交失败', '上传验证', '人工释放占用', '撤回待改单', '创建') AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL), current_open_orders AS (SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code, l.pickup_point AS pickup_point FROM current_order_lines AS l GROUP BY l.cust_order_no, l.cust_code, l.pickup_point HAVING MAX(l.unshipped) = 1), current_open_lines AS (SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code, l.material_code AS material_code, l.material_name AS material_name, l.pickup_point AS pickup_point, l.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name, l.belong_base AS belong_base, l.demand_qty AS demand_qty, l.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty FROM current_order_lines AS l INNER JOIN current_open_orders AS o ON l.cust_order_no = o.cust_order_no AND (l.cust_code = o.cust_code OR (l.cust_code IS NULL AND o.cust_code IS NULL)) AND (l.pickup_point = o.pickup_point OR (l.pickup_point IS NULL AND o.pickup_point IS NULL))), eligible_order_sku AS (SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END AS location_type, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL')) ELSE m.location_code END AS location_code, MAX(COALESCE(m.location_name, o.pickup_point_name)) AS location_name, MAX(COALESCE(m.belong_base, o.belong_base)) AS belong_base, MAX(m.warehouseid) AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.demand_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.allocated_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) <> COUNT(*) OR COUNT(o.allocated_qty) <> COUNT(*) OR MIN(o.demand_qty) < 0 OR MIN(o.allocated_qty) < 0 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty) > 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty) ELSE 0 END AS remaining_qty, COUNT(*) AS source_row_count, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL OR o.demand_qty IS NULL OR o.allocated_qty IS NULL OR o.demand_qty < 0 OR o.allocated_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS input_invalid FROM current_open_lines AS o LEFT JOIN point_locations AS m ON o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point WHERE (NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL) GROUP BY o.cust_order_no, o.cust_code, o.material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL')) ELSE m.location_code END), fc_order_keys AS (SELECT o.location_type AS location_type, o.warehouseid AS warehouseid, o.material_code AS material_code FROM eligible_order_sku AS o GROUP BY o.location_type, o.warehouseid, o.material_code), source_records AS (SELECT t.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name FROM agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS t WHERE t.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', ''), 1, 6) GROUP BY t.warehouse_code, t.material_code), branch_stock_keys AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') GROUP BY b.warehouseid, b.material_code), source_keys AS (SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.material_code AS material_code FROM source_records AS s UNION ALL SELECT h.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, h.material_code AS material_code FROM branch_stock_keys AS h WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, co.material_code AS material_code FROM fc_order_keys AS co WHERE co.location_type = '分仓' AND NOT co.material_code IS NULL AND NOT co.warehouseid IS NULL), scope_keys AS (SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, k.material_code AS material_code FROM source_keys AS k JOIN fc_branch_scope AS bs ON bs.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code GROUP BY k.warehouse_code, k.material_code), inventory_batch_dates AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code, b.month_date AS month_date, b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.material_name AS material_name FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')), inventory_batch_ages AS (SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code, d.month_date AS month_date, d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.material_name AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d), inventory_batch_totals AS (SELECT CAST(CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2), '')) AS DATE) AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code), inventory_batch_names AS (SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid, n.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n GROUP BY n.warehouseid, n.material_code), inventory_batch_source AS (SELECT a.stat_date AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, COALESCE(a.warehouse_name, a.warehouseid) AS warehouse_name, a.material_name AS material_name, n.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name FROM inventory_batch_totals AS a LEFT JOIN inventory_batch_names AS n ON n.warehouseid = a.warehouseid AND n.material_code = a.material_code), branch_stock AS (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(t.product_categ_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_categ_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, t.material_code AS material_code, t.warehouseid AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.warehouse_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.warehouse_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_source AS t WHERE t.stat_date = CAST(:gea_p2200 AS DATE) GROUP BY t.stat_date, t.warehouseid, t.material_code), branch_shipments AS (SELECT t.warehouse AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS category FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS t WHERE t.warehouse_classify = '20' AND t.act_ship_date >= :gea_p2000 AND t.act_ship_date < :gea_p2001 GROUP BY t.warehouse, t.material_code), flow_names AS (SELECT t.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS t GROUP BY t.warehouseid, t.material_code), product_list_dictionary AS (SELECT t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi AS t WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY t.material_code), combined AS (SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, k.material_code AS sku, COALESCE(h.warehouse_name, s.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(h.material_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(s.material_name), ''), sh.material_name, n.material_name)), ''), pm.material_name) AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.product_categ_name), ''), h.product_categ_name, sh.category) AS category FROM scope_keys AS k LEFT JOIN source_records AS s ON (s.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code OR (s.warehouse_code IS NULL AND k.warehouse_code IS NULL)) AND (s.material_code = k.material_code OR (s.material_code IS NULL AND k.material_code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN branch_stock AS h ON h.warehouseid = k.warehouse_code AND h.material_code = k.material_code AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL LEFT JOIN branch_shipments AS sh ON sh.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code AND sh.sku = k.material_code LEFT JOIN flow_names AS n ON n.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code AND n.material_code = k.material_code LEFT JOIN product_list_dictionary AS pm ON pm.sku = k.material_code), location_sku_demand AS (SELECT eligible_order_sku.location_type AS location_type, eligible_order_sku.location_code AS location_code, eligible_order_sku.material_code AS material_code, MAX(eligible_order_sku.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(eligible_order_sku.belong_base) AS belong_base, MAX(eligible_order_sku.warehouseid) AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT eligible_order_sku.material_name) = 1 THEN MAX(eligible_order_sku.material_name) END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) END AS remaining_qty, SUM(eligible_order_sku.source_row_count) AS source_row_count, COUNT(*) AS order_sku_count, MAX(eligible_order_sku.input_invalid) AS input_invalid FROM eligible_order_sku AS eligible_order_sku GROUP BY eligible_order_sku.location_type, eligible_order_sku.location_code, eligible_order_sku.material_code), complete_demand AS (SELECT location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type, location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code, location_sku_demand.material_code AS material_code, location_sku_demand.location_name AS location_name, location_sku_demand.belong_base AS belong_base, location_sku_demand.warehouseid AS warehouseid, location_sku_demand.material_name AS material_name, location_sku_demand.demand_qty AS demand_qty, location_sku_demand.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty, location_sku_demand.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty, location_sku_demand.source_row_count AS source_row_count, location_sku_demand.order_sku_count AS order_sku_count, location_sku_demand.input_invalid AS input_invalid FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand UNION ALL SELECT l.location_type AS location_type, l.location_code AS location_code, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_code, MAX(l.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(l.belong_base) AS belong_base, CASE WHEN l.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(l.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_name, 0 AS demand_qty, 0 AS allocated_qty, 0 AS remaining_qty, 0 AS source_row_count, 0 AS order_sku_count, 0 AS input_invalid FROM inventory_rows AS l LEFT JOIN (SELECT location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type, location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand GROUP BY location_sku_demand.location_type, location_sku_demand.location_code) AS d ON l.location_type = d.location_type AND l.location_code = d.location_code WHERE d.location_code IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(l.location_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY l.location_type, l.location_code), inventory_batch AS (SELECT inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type, inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code, inventory_rows.material_code AS material_code, inventory_rows.warehouseid AS warehouseid, inventory_rows.prod_date AS prod_date, inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid, inventory_rows.plant AS plant, inventory_rows.quality_batch AS quality_batch, inventory_rows.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod, inventory_rows.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, SUM(COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0)) AS available_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 END) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS duplicate_batch FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows GROUP BY inventory_rows.location_type, inventory_rows.location_code, inventory_rows.material_code, inventory_rows.warehouseid, inventory_rows.prod_date, inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid, inventory_rows.plant, inventory_rows.quality_batch, inventory_rows.is_good_prod, inventory_rows.warehouse_classify), inventory_sku AS (SELECT inventory_batch.location_type AS location_type, inventory_batch.location_code AS location_code, inventory_batch.material_code AS material_code, SUM(inventory_batch.available_qty) AS available_qty, SUM(inventory_batch.duplicate_batch) AS duplicate_batch FROM inventory_batch AS inventory_batch GROUP BY inventory_batch.location_type, inventory_batch.location_code, inventory_batch.material_code), material_attributes AS (SELECT agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.product_categ_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.product_categ_name), '')) END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_group_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_group_name), '')) END AS material_group_name FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d GROUP BY agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code), fc_current_orders AS (SELECT d.location_type AS location_type, d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code FROM complete_demand AS d CROSS JOIN latest_inventory AS s LEFT JOIN inventory_sku AS i ON d.location_type = i.location_type AND d.location_code = i.location_code AND d.material_code = i.material_code LEFT JOIN material_attributes AS a ON d.material_code = a.material_code), fc_order_presence AS (SELECT MAX(1) AS _ FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o), fc_net_input AS (SELECT r.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, r.sku AS sku, r.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category FROM combined AS r LEFT JOIN fc_current_orders AS co ON co.location_type = '分仓' AND co.warehouseid = r.warehouse_code AND co.material_code = r.sku CROSS JOIN fc_order_presence AS op CROSS JOIN latest_inventory AS li), measured AS (SELECT r.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, r.sku AS sku, r.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category FROM fc_net_input AS r), filtered AS (SELECT 1 AS _ FROM measured AS r WHERE (:gea_p1 = 'all' OR (:gea_p1 = 'equal' AND r.warehouse_code = :gea_p2) OR (:gea_p1 = 'missing' AND r.warehouse_code IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p3 = 'all' OR (:gea_p3 = 'equal' AND r.sku = :gea_p4) OR (:gea_p3 = 'missing' AND r.sku IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p5 = 'all' OR (:gea_p5 = 'equal' AND r.category = :gea_p6) OR (:gea_p5 = 'missing' AND r.category IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p7 IS NULL OR LOWER(r.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p7) OR LOWER(r.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p7) OR LOWER(r.warehouse_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p7))) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM filtered AS r

replenishment.summary.title: 分仓补货完整范围汇总
