request.sql: WITH fc_branch_scope AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouse_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid), '') IS NULL GROUP BY b.warehouseid), latest_inventory AS (SELECT MAX(agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.month_date) AS month_date FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d WHERE agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), warehouse_points AS (SELECT agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) END AS pickup_point FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d GROUP BY agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid), inventory_rows AS (SELECT i.month_date AS month_date, i.warehouseid AS warehouseid, i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, i.belong_base AS belong_base, i.material_code AS material_code, i.material_name AS material_name, i.prod_date AS prod_date, i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid, i.plant AS plant, i.quality_batch AS quality_batch, i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod, i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, i.available_qty AS available_qty, w.pickup_point AS pickup_point, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s ON i.month_date = s.month_date LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid WHERE i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), point_location_candidates AS (SELECT inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type, inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code, MAX(inventory_rows.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(inventory_rows.belong_base) AS belong_base, CASE WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(inventory_rows.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid, COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.location_name) AS name_count, COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.belong_base) AS base_count FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows WHERE NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY inventory_rows.pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type, inventory_rows.location_code), point_locations AS (SELECT point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_code) AS location_code, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(point_location_candidates.belong_base) AS belong_base, MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates GROUP BY point_location_candidates.pickup_point HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1), current_order_lines AS (SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.cust_code AS cust_code, o.material_code AS material_code, o.material_name AS material_name, o.pickup_point AS pickup_point, o.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name, o.belong_base AS belong_base, o.qtyordered AS demand_qty, o.qtyallocated AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty < o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o WHERE o.detailstatus = 10 AND o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波', '组波中', '组波完成', '组波失败', '提交成功', '提交中', '提交失败', '上传验证', '人工释放占用', '撤回待改单', '创建') AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL), current_open_orders AS (SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code, l.pickup_point AS pickup_point FROM current_order_lines AS l GROUP BY l.cust_order_no, l.cust_code, l.pickup_point HAVING MAX(l.unshipped) = 1), current_open_lines AS (SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code, l.material_code AS material_code, l.material_name AS material_name, l.pickup_point AS pickup_point, l.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name, l.belong_base AS belong_base, l.demand_qty AS demand_qty, l.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty FROM current_order_lines AS l INNER JOIN current_open_orders AS o ON l.cust_order_no = o.cust_order_no AND (l.cust_code = o.cust_code OR (l.cust_code IS NULL AND o.cust_code IS NULL)) AND (l.pickup_point = o.pickup_point OR (l.pickup_point IS NULL AND o.pickup_point IS NULL))), eligible_order_sku AS (SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END AS location_type, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL')) ELSE m.location_code END AS location_code, MAX(COALESCE(m.location_name, o.pickup_point_name)) AS location_name, MAX(COALESCE(m.belong_base, o.belong_base)) AS belong_base, MAX(m.warehouseid) AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.demand_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.allocated_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) <> COUNT(*) OR COUNT(o.allocated_qty) <> COUNT(*) OR MIN(o.demand_qty) < 0 OR MIN(o.allocated_qty) < 0 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty) > 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty) ELSE 0 END AS remaining_qty, COUNT(*) AS source_row_count, MAX(CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL OR o.demand_qty IS NULL OR o.allocated_qty IS NULL OR o.demand_qty < 0 OR o.allocated_qty < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS input_invalid FROM current_open_lines AS o LEFT JOIN point_locations AS m ON o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point WHERE (NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL) GROUP BY o.cust_order_no, o.cust_code, o.material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL')) ELSE m.location_code END), fc_order_keys AS (SELECT o.location_type AS location_type, o.warehouseid AS warehouseid, o.material_code AS material_code FROM eligible_order_sku AS o GROUP BY o.location_type, o.warehouseid, o.material_code), source_records AS (SELECT t.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_future30_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_future30_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_transfer_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_transfer_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_onway_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_onway_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_prepare_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_prepare_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.stat_month) ELSE NULL END AS stat_month, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS t WHERE t.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', ''), 1, 6) GROUP BY t.warehouse_code, t.material_code), branch_stock_keys AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') GROUP BY b.warehouseid, b.material_code), source_keys AS (SELECT s.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, s.material_code AS material_code FROM source_records AS s UNION ALL SELECT h.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, h.material_code AS material_code FROM branch_stock_keys AS h WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, co.material_code AS material_code FROM fc_order_keys AS co WHERE co.location_type = '分仓' AND NOT co.material_code IS NULL AND NOT co.warehouseid IS NULL), scope_keys AS (SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, k.material_code AS material_code FROM source_keys AS k JOIN fc_branch_scope AS bs ON bs.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code GROUP BY k.warehouse_code, k.material_code), inventory_batch_dates AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code, b.month_date AS month_date, b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.material_name AS material_name, b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty, b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2200 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')), inventory_batch_ages AS (SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code, d.month_date AS month_date, d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.material_name AS material_name, d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty, d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d), inventory_batch_totals AS (SELECT CAST(CONCAT(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 1, 4), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 5, 2), ''), '-', COALESCE(SUBSTRING(a.month_date, 7, 2), '')) AS DATE) AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(COALESCE(a.live_qty, 0)) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS total_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0)) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty, 0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty, 0)) AS freeze_qty FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code), inventory_batch_names AS (SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid, n.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(n.material_group_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(n.material_group_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n GROUP BY n.warehouseid, n.material_code), inventory_batch_source AS (SELECT a.stat_date AS stat_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code, COALESCE(a.warehouse_name, a.warehouseid) AS warehouse_name, a.material_name AS material_name, n.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, n.material_group_name AS material_group_name, a.total_qty AS total_qty, a.available_qty AS available_qty, a.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, a.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty FROM inventory_batch_totals AS a LEFT JOIN inventory_batch_names AS n ON n.warehouseid = a.warehouseid AND n.material_code = a.material_code), branch_stock AS (SELECT t.stat_date AS stat_date, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.product_categ_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_categ_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.material_group_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.material_group_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.total_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.total_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.total_qty) ELSE NULL END AS total_qty, t.warehouseid AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.warehouse_name) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.warehouse_name) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.available_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.available_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.available_qty) ELSE NULL END AS available_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.pack_unit_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.pack_unit_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.pack_unit_qty) ELSE NULL END AS pack_unit_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.freeze_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT t.freeze_qty) = 1 THEN MAX(t.freeze_qty) ELSE NULL END AS freeze_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name FROM inventory_batch_source AS t WHERE t.stat_date = CAST(:gea_p2200 AS DATE) GROUP BY t.stat_date, t.warehouseid, t.material_code), branch_shipments AS (SELECT t.warehouse AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.material_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.material_group_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.material_group_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, '')) ELSE NULL END AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date >= :gea_p2002 AND t.act_dl_qty > 0 THEN t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END) AS month_ship_positive, SUM(CASE WHEN t.act_ship_date >= :gea_p2003 AND t.act_dl_qty > 0 THEN t.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END) AS rolling_ship_positive FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS t WHERE t.warehouse_classify = '20' AND t.act_ship_date >= :gea_p2000 AND t.act_ship_date < :gea_p2001 GROUP BY t.warehouse, t.material_code), flow_names AS (SELECT t.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_group_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_group_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS t GROUP BY t.warehouseid, t.material_code), product_list_dictionary AS (SELECT t.material_code AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(t.product_item_name), '')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi AS t WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(t.material_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY t.material_code), combined AS (SELECT k.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, k.material_code AS sku, COALESCE(h.warehouse_name, s.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(h.material_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(s.material_name), ''), sh.material_name, n.material_name)), ''), pm.material_name) AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.product_categ_name), ''), h.product_categ_name, sh.category) AS category, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(sh.material_group, n.material_group, h.material_group_name)), ''), pm.material_group) AS material_group, h.total_qty AS inventory_qty, h.available_qty AS available_qty, COALESCE(h.pack_unit_qty, 0) AS occupied_qty, COALESCE(h.freeze_qty, 0) AS frozen_qty, h.stat_date AS stock_date, CASE WHEN h.warehouseid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS stock_present, CASE WHEN s.source_rows IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS plan_present, CASE WHEN s.transfer_prepare_qty IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS preparing_present, CASE WHEN s.transfer_onway_qty IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS in_transit_present, s.warehouse_month_out_plan AS month_out_plan, s.warehouse_future30_qty AS future30_qty, CASE WHEN s.warehouse_transfer_qty >= 0 THEN s.warehouse_transfer_qty WHEN s.warehouse_transfer_qty IS NULL AND s.transfer_onway_qty >= 0 AND s.transfer_prepare_qty >= 0 THEN s.transfer_onway_qty + s.transfer_prepare_qty ELSE NULL END AS open_transfer_reported_qty, COALESCE(s.transfer_onway_qty, 0) AS in_transit, COALESCE(s.transfer_prepare_qty, 0) AS preparing, COALESCE(sh.month_ship_positive, 0) AS month_ship_positive, COALESCE(sh.rolling_ship_positive, 0) AS rolling_ship_positive, COALESCE(sh.rolling_ship_positive, 0) / 30.0 AS rolling_ship_daily, CASE WHEN s.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', ''), 1, 6) AND s.source_rows = 1 AND s.warehouse_month_out_plan >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS plan_calculable FROM scope_keys AS k LEFT JOIN source_records AS s ON (s.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code OR (s.warehouse_code IS NULL AND k.warehouse_code IS NULL)) AND (s.material_code = k.material_code OR (s.material_code IS NULL AND k.material_code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN branch_stock AS h ON h.warehouseid = k.warehouse_code AND h.material_code = k.material_code AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(h.warehouseid), '') IS NULL LEFT JOIN branch_shipments AS sh ON sh.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code AND sh.sku = k.material_code LEFT JOIN flow_names AS n ON n.warehouse_code = k.warehouse_code AND n.material_code = k.material_code LEFT JOIN product_list_dictionary AS pm ON pm.sku = k.material_code), location_sku_demand AS (SELECT eligible_order_sku.location_type AS location_type, eligible_order_sku.location_code AS location_code, eligible_order_sku.material_code AS material_code, MAX(eligible_order_sku.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(eligible_order_sku.belong_base) AS belong_base, MAX(eligible_order_sku.warehouseid) AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT eligible_order_sku.material_name) = 1 THEN MAX(eligible_order_sku.material_name) END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) END AS remaining_qty, SUM(eligible_order_sku.source_row_count) AS source_row_count, COUNT(*) AS order_sku_count, MAX(eligible_order_sku.input_invalid) AS input_invalid FROM eligible_order_sku AS eligible_order_sku GROUP BY eligible_order_sku.location_type, eligible_order_sku.location_code, eligible_order_sku.material_code), complete_demand AS (SELECT location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type, location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code, location_sku_demand.material_code AS material_code, location_sku_demand.location_name AS location_name, location_sku_demand.belong_base AS belong_base, location_sku_demand.warehouseid AS warehouseid, location_sku_demand.material_name AS material_name, location_sku_demand.demand_qty AS demand_qty, location_sku_demand.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty, location_sku_demand.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty, location_sku_demand.source_row_count AS source_row_count, location_sku_demand.order_sku_count AS order_sku_count, location_sku_demand.input_invalid AS input_invalid FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand UNION ALL SELECT l.location_type AS location_type, l.location_code AS location_code, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_code, MAX(l.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(l.belong_base) AS belong_base, CASE WHEN l.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(l.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_name, 0 AS demand_qty, 0 AS allocated_qty, 0 AS remaining_qty, 0 AS source_row_count, 0 AS order_sku_count, 0 AS input_invalid FROM inventory_rows AS l LEFT JOIN (SELECT location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type, location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand GROUP BY location_sku_demand.location_type, location_sku_demand.location_code) AS d ON l.location_type = d.location_type AND l.location_code = d.location_code WHERE d.location_code IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(l.location_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY l.location_type, l.location_code), inventory_batch AS (SELECT inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type, inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code, inventory_rows.material_code AS material_code, inventory_rows.warehouseid AS warehouseid, inventory_rows.prod_date AS prod_date, inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid, inventory_rows.plant AS plant, inventory_rows.quality_batch AS quality_batch, inventory_rows.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod, inventory_rows.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, SUM(COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0)) AS available_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 END) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS duplicate_batch FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows GROUP BY inventory_rows.location_type, inventory_rows.location_code, inventory_rows.material_code, inventory_rows.warehouseid, inventory_rows.prod_date, inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid, inventory_rows.plant, inventory_rows.quality_batch, inventory_rows.is_good_prod, inventory_rows.warehouse_classify), inventory_sku AS (SELECT inventory_batch.location_type AS location_type, inventory_batch.location_code AS location_code, inventory_batch.material_code AS material_code, SUM(inventory_batch.available_qty) AS available_qty, SUM(inventory_batch.duplicate_batch) AS duplicate_batch FROM inventory_batch AS inventory_batch GROUP BY inventory_batch.location_type, inventory_batch.location_code, inventory_batch.material_code), material_attributes AS (SELECT agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code AS request.sql:
WITH latest_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.month_date) AS month_date
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d
  WHERE
    agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), warehouse_points AS (
  SELECT
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), ''))
    END AS pickup_point
  FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d
  GROUP BY
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid
), inventory_rows AS (
  SELECT
    i.month_date AS month_date,
    i.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
    i.belong_base AS belong_base,
    i.material_code AS material_code,
    i.material_name AS material_name,
    i.prod_date AS prod_date,
    i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,
    i.plant AS plant,
    i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,
    i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,
    i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
    i.available_qty AS available_qty,
    w.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
  INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s
    ON i.month_date = s.month_date
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w
    ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid
  WHERE
    i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), point_location_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code,
    MAX(inventory_rows.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(inventory_rows.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    CASE
      WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓'
      THEN MAX(inventory_rows.warehouseid)
    END AS warehouseid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.location_name) AS name_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.belong_base) AS base_count
  FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows
  WHERE
    NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    inventory_rows.pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code
), point_locations AS (
  SELECT
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_code) AS location_code,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid
  FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates
  GROUP BY
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1
), current_order_lines AS (
  SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.cust_code AS cust_code,
    o.material_code AS material_code, o.material_name AS material_name,
    o.pickup_point AS pickup_point, o.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name,
    o.belong_base AS belong_base, o.qtyordered AS demand_qty,
    o.qtyallocated AS allocated_qty,
    CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL
      OR o.delivery_qty < o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped
  FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o
  WHERE o.detailstatus = 10
    AND o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波','组波中','组波完成','组波失败','提交成功','提交中','提交失败','上传验证','人工释放占用','撤回待改单','创建')
    AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NOT NULL
), current_open_orders AS (
  SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code,
    l.pickup_point AS pickup_point
  FROM current_order_lines AS l
  GROUP BY l.cust_order_no, l.cust_code, l.pickup_point
  HAVING MAX(l.unshipped) = 1
), current_open_lines AS (
  SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code,
    l.material_code AS material_code, l.material_name AS material_name,
    l.pickup_point AS pickup_point, l.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name,
    l.belong_base AS belong_base, l.demand_qty AS demand_qty,
    l.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty
  FROM current_order_lines AS l INNER JOIN current_open_orders AS o
    ON l.cust_order_no = o.cust_order_no
    AND (l.cust_code = o.cust_code OR (l.cust_code IS NULL AND o.cust_code IS NULL))
    AND (l.pickup_point = o.pickup_point OR (l.pickup_point IS NULL AND o.pickup_point IS NULL))
), eligible_order_sku AS (
  SELECT
    o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no,
    o.material_code AS material_code,
    CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END AS location_type,
    CASE
      WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
      THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'))
      ELSE m.location_code
    END AS location_code,
    MAX(COALESCE(m.location_name, o.pickup_point_name)) AS location_name,
    MAX(COALESCE(m.belong_base, o.belong_base)) AS belong_base,
    MAX(m.warehouseid) AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), ''))
    END AS material_name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.demand_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(o.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.allocated_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) <> COUNT(*) OR COUNT(o.allocated_qty) <> COUNT(*)
        OR MIN(o.demand_qty) < 0 OR MIN(o.allocated_qty) < 0 THEN NULL
      WHEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty) > 0
      THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty)
      ELSE 0
    END AS remaining_qty,
    COUNT(*) AS source_row_count,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL
        OR o.demand_qty IS NULL OR o.allocated_qty IS NULL
        OR o.demand_qty < 0 OR o.allocated_qty < 0
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS input_invalid
  FROM current_open_lines AS o
  LEFT JOIN point_locations AS m
    ON o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point
  WHERE
    (
      NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    o.cust_order_no,
    o.cust_code,
    o.material_code,
    CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END,
    CASE
      WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
      THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'))
      ELSE m.location_code
    END
), location_sku_demand AS (
  SELECT
    eligible_order_sku.location_type AS location_type,
    eligible_order_sku.location_code AS location_code,
    eligible_order_sku.material_code AS material_code,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.warehouseid) AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT eligible_order_sku.material_name) = 1
      THEN MAX(eligible_order_sku.material_name)
    END AS material_name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) END AS remaining_qty,
    SUM(eligible_order_sku.source_row_count) AS source_row_count,
    COUNT(*) AS order_sku_count,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.input_invalid) AS input_invalid
  FROM eligible_order_sku AS eligible_order_sku
  GROUP BY
    eligible_order_sku.location_type,
    eligible_order_sku.location_code,
    eligible_order_sku.material_code
), complete_demand AS (
  SELECT
    location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type,
    location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code,
    location_sku_demand.material_code AS material_code,
    location_sku_demand.location_name AS location_name,
    location_sku_demand.belong_base AS belong_base,
    location_sku_demand.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    location_sku_demand.material_name AS material_name,
    location_sku_demand.demand_qty AS demand_qty,
    location_sku_demand.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty,
    location_sku_demand.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty,
    location_sku_demand.source_row_count AS source_row_count,
    location_sku_demand.order_sku_count AS order_sku_count,
    location_sku_demand.input_invalid AS input_invalid
  FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    l.location_type AS location_type,
    l.location_code AS location_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_code,
    MAX(l.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(l.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    CASE WHEN l.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(l.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_name,
    0 AS demand_qty,
    0 AS allocated_qty,
    0 AS remaining_qty,
    0 AS source_row_count,
    0 AS order_sku_count,
    0 AS input_invalid
  FROM inventory_rows AS l
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type,
      location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code
    FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand
    GROUP BY
      location_sku_demand.location_type,
      location_sku_demand.location_code
  ) AS d
    ON l.location_type = d.location_type AND l.location_code = d.location_code
  WHERE
    d.location_code IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(l.location_code), '') IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    l.location_type,
    l.location_code
), inventory_batch AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code,
    inventory_rows.material_code AS material_code,
    inventory_rows.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.prod_date AS prod_date,
    inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.plant AS plant,
    inventory_rows.quality_batch AS quality_batch,
    inventory_rows.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,
    inventory_rows.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
    SUM(COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0)) AS available_qty,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 END) > 1
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS duplicate_batch
  FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows
  GROUP BY

request.sql:
WITH latest_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.month_date) AS month_date
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d
  WHERE
    agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), warehouse_points AS (
  SELECT
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), ''))
    END AS pickup_point
  FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d
  GROUP BY
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid
), inventory_rows AS (
  SELECT
    i.month_date AS month_date,
    i.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
    i.belong_base AS belong_base,
    i.material_code AS material_code,
    i.material_name AS material_name,
    i.prod_date AS prod_date,
    i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,
    i.plant AS plant,
    i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,
    i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,
    i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
    i.available_qty AS available_qty,
    w.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
  INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s
    ON i.month_date = s.month_date
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w
    ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid
  WHERE
    i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), point_location_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code,
    MAX(inventory_rows.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(inventory_rows.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    CASE
      WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓'
      THEN MAX(inventory_rows.warehouseid)
    END AS warehouseid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.location_name) AS name_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.belong_base) AS base_count
  FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows
  WHERE
    NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    inventory_rows.pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code
), point_locations AS (
  SELECT
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_code) AS location_code,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid
  FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates
  GROUP BY
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1
), current_order_lines AS (
  SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.cust_code AS cust_code,
    o.material_code AS material_code, o.material_name AS material_name,
    o.pickup_point AS pickup_point, o.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name,
    o.belong_base AS belong_base, o.qtyordered AS demand_qty,
    o.qtyallocated AS allocated_qty,
    CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL
      OR o.delivery_qty < o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped
  FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o
  WHERE o.detailstatus = 10
    AND o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波','组波中','组波完成','组波失败','提交成功','提交中','提交失败','上传验证','人工释放占用','撤回待改单','创建')
    AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NOT NULL
), current_open_orders AS (
  SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code,
    l.pickup_point AS pickup_point
  FROM current_order_lines AS l
  GROUP BY l.cust_order_no, l.cust_code, l.pickup_point
  HAVING MAX(l.unshipped) = 1
), current_open_lines AS (
  SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code,
    l.material_code AS material_code, l.material_name AS material_name,
    l.pickup_point AS pickup_point, l.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name,
    l.belong_base AS belong_base, l.demand_qty AS demand_qty,
    l.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty
  FROM current_order_lines AS l INNER JOIN current_open_orders AS o
    ON l.cust_order_no = o.cust_order_no
    AND (l.cust_code = o.cust_code OR (l.cust_code IS NULL AND o.cust_code IS NULL))
    AND (l.pickup_point = o.pickup_point OR (l.pickup_point IS NULL AND o.pickup_point IS NULL))
), eligible_order_sku AS (
  SELECT
    o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no,
    o.material_code AS material_code,
    CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END AS location_type,
    CASE
      WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
      THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'))
      ELSE m.location_code
    END AS location_code,
    MAX(COALESCE(m.location_name, o.pickup_point_name)) AS location_name,
    MAX(COALESCE(m.belong_base, o.belong_base)) AS belong_base,
    MAX(m.warehouseid) AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), ''))
    END AS material_name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.demand_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(o.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.allocated_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) <> COUNT(*) OR COUNT(o.allocated_qty) <> COUNT(*)
        OR MIN(o.demand_qty) < 0 OR MIN(o.allocated_qty) < 0 THEN NULL
      WHEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty) > 0
      THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty)
      ELSE 0
    END AS remaining_qty,
    COUNT(*) AS source_row_count,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL
        OR o.demand_qty IS NULL OR o.allocated_qty IS NULL
        OR o.demand_qty < 0 OR o.allocated_qty < 0
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS input_invalid
  FROM current_open_lines AS o
  LEFT JOIN point_locations AS m
    ON o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point
  WHERE
    (
      NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    o.cust_order_no,
    o.cust_code,
    o.material_code,
    CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END,
    CASE
      WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
      THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'))
      ELSE m.location_code
    END
), location_sku_demand AS (
  SELECT
    eligible_order_sku.location_type AS location_type,
    eligible_order_sku.location_code AS location_code,
    eligible_order_sku.material_code AS material_code,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.warehouseid) AS warehouseid,

      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT eligible_order_sku.material_name) = 1

    END AS material_name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) END AS remaining_qty,
    SUM(eligible_order_sku.source_row_count) AS source_row_count,
    COUNT(*) AS order_sku_count,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.input_invalid) AS input_invalid
  FROM eligible_order_sku AS eligible_order_sku
  GROUP BY
    eligible_order_sku.location_type,
    eligible_order_sku.location_code,
    eligible_order_sku.material_code

    AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL

      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), ''))

    CASE WHEN COUNT(o.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.allocated_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty,

        OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL

    o.cust_code,
    o.material_code,
    CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END,
    CASE

  FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows
  GROUP BY

    inventory_rows.location_code,
    inventory_rows.material_code,
    inventory_rows.warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.prod_date,
    inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.plant,
    inventory_rows.quality_batch,
    inventory_rows.is_good_prod,
    inventory_rows.warehouse_classify
), material_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code AS material_code,

      WHEN COUNT(
        DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.product_categ_name), '')

      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.product_categ_name), ''))
    END AS product_categ_name,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(

  a.material_group_name AS material_group_name,

  d.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty,
  d.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN d.input_invalid = 0

    WHEN d.input_invalid = 0
    AND COALESCE(i.duplicate_batch, 0) = 0
    AND NOT s.month_date IS NULL

      WHEN d.remaining_qty - COALESCE(i.available_qty, 0) > 0

  d.order_sku_count AS order_sku_count,

    ELSE 0

    WHEN d.order_sku_count > 0

    AND d.input_invalid = 0
    AND NOT s.month_date IS NULL
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0

 ORDER BY f.location_type, f.location_code, f.sku LIMIT :gea_p4 OFFSET :gea_p5)
 SELECT p.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, p.location_type AS location_type, p.location_code AS location_code, p.location_name AS location_name, p.base AS base, p.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, p.sku AS sku, p.material_name AS material_name, p.category AS category, p.material_group AS material_group, p.demand AS demand, p.allocated AS allocated, p.remaining AS remaining, p.available AS available, p.shortage AS shortage, p.invalid AS invalid, t.page_scope_total AS page_scope_total,
 CASE WHEN p.location_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS page_row_present
 FROM scope_count AS t LEFT JOIN page_rows AS p ON TRUE
 ORDER BY p.location_type, p.location_code, p.sku

    CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL
      OR o.delivery_qty < o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped
  FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o
  WHERE o.detailstatus = 10
    AND o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波','组波中','组波完成','组波失败','提交成功','提交中','提交失败','上传验证','人工释放占用','撤回待改单','创建')
    AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NOT NULL
), current_open_orders AS (
  SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code,
    l.pickup_point AS pickup_point
  FROM current_order_lines AS l
  GROUP BY l.cust_order_no, l.cust_code, l.pickup_point
  HAVING MAX(l.unshipped) = 1
), current_open_lines AS (
  SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code,
    l.material_code AS material_code, l.material_name AS material_name,
    l.pickup_point AS pickup_point, l.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name,
    l.belong_base AS belong_base, l.demand_qty AS demand_qty,
    l.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty
  FROM current_order_lines AS l INNER JOIN current_open_orders AS o
    ON l.cust_order_no = o.cust_order_no
    AND (l.cust_code = o.cust_code OR (l.cust_code IS NULL AND o.cust_code IS NULL))
    AND (l.pickup_point = o.pickup_point OR (l.pickup_point IS NULL AND o.pickup_point IS NULL))
), eligible_order_sku AS (
  SELECT
    o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no,
    o.material_code AS material_code,
    CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END AS location_type,
    CASE
      WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
      THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'))
      ELSE m.location_code
    END AS location_code,
    MAX(COALESCE(m.location_name, o.pickup_point_name)) AS location_name,
    MAX(COALESCE(m.belong_base, o.belong_base)) AS belong_base,
    MAX(m.warehouseid) AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), ''))
    END AS material_name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.demand_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(o.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.allocated_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) <> COUNT(*) OR COUNT(o.allocated_qty) <> COUNT(*)
        OR MIN(o.demand_qty) < 0 OR MIN(o.allocated_qty) < 0 THEN NULL
      WHEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty) > 0
      THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) - SUM(o.allocated_qty)
      ELSE 0
    END AS remaining_qty,
    COUNT(*) AS source_row_count,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL
        OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_code), '') IS NULL
        OR o.demand_qty IS NULL OR o.allocated_qty IS NULL
        OR o.demand_qty < 0 OR o.allocated_qty < 0
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS input_invalid
  FROM current_open_lines AS o
  LEFT JOIN point_locations AS m
    ON o.pickup_point = m.pickup_point
  WHERE
    (
      NOT m.pickup_point IS NULL OR NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.belong_base), '') IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    o.cust_order_no,
    o.cust_code,
    o.material_code,
    CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END,
    CASE
      WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL
      THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL'))
      ELSE m.location_code
    END
), location_sku_demand AS (
  SELECT
    eligible_order_sku.location_type AS location_type,
    eligible_order_sku.location_code AS location_code,
    eligible_order_sku.material_code AS material_code,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.warehouseid) AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT eligible_order_sku.material_name) = 1
      THEN MAX(eligible_order_sku.material_name)
    END AS material_name,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.allocated_qty) END AS allocated_qty,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(eligible_order_sku.remaining_qty) END AS remaining_qty,
    SUM(eligible_order_sku.source_row_count) AS source_row_count,
    COUNT(*) AS order_sku_count,
    MAX(eligible_order_sku.input_invalid) AS input_invalid
  FROM eligible_order_sku AS eligible_order_sku
  GROUP BY
    eligible_order_sku.location_type,
    eligible_order_sku.location_code,
    eligible_order_sku.material_code
), complete_demand AS (
  SELECT
    location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type,
    location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code,
    location_sku_demand.material_code AS material_code,
    location_sku_demand.location_name AS location_name,
    location_sku_demand.belong_base AS belong_base,
    location_sku_demand.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    location_sku_demand.material_name AS material_name,
    location_sku_demand.demand_qty AS demand_qty,
    location_sku_demand.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty,
    location_sku_demand.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty,
    location_sku_demand.source_row_count AS source_row_count,
    location_sku_demand.order_sku_count AS order_sku_count,
    location_sku_demand.input_invalid AS input_invalid
  FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    l.location_type AS location_type,
    l.location_code AS location_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_code,
    MAX(l.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(l.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    CASE WHEN l.location_type = '分仓' THEN MAX(l.warehouseid) END AS warehouseid,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS material_name,
    0 AS demand_qty,
    0 AS allocated_qty,
    0 AS remaining_qty,
    0 AS source_row_count,
    0 AS order_sku_count,
    0 AS input_invalid
  FROM inventory_rows AS l
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      location_sku_demand.location_type AS location_type,
      location_sku_demand.location_code AS location_code
    FROM location_sku_demand AS location_sku_demand
    GROUP BY
      location_sku_demand.location_type,
      location_sku_demand.location_code
  ) AS d
    ON l.location_type = d.location_type AND l.location_code = d.location_code
  WHERE
    d.location_code IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(l.location_code), '') IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    l.location_type,
    l.location_code
), inventory_batch AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code,
    inventory_rows.material_code AS material_code,
    inventory_rows.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.prod_date AS prod_date,
    inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.plant AS plant,
    inventory_rows.quality_batch AS quality_batch,
    inventory_rows.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,
    inventory_rows.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
    SUM(COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0)) AS available_qty,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(inventory_rows.available_qty, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 END) > 1
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS duplicate_batch
  FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows
  GROUP BY
    inventory_rows.location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code,
    inventory_rows.material_code,
    inventory_rows.warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.prod_date,
    inventory_rows.sap_warehouseid,
    inventory_rows.plant,
    inventory_rows.quality_batch,
    inventory_rows.is_good_prod,
    inventory_rows.warehouse_classify
), material_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code AS material_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(
        DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.product_categ_name), '')
      ) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.product_categ_name), ''))
    END AS product_categ_name,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(
        DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_group_name), '')
      ) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_group_name), ''))
    END AS material_group_name
  FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d
  GROUP BY
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.material_code
), inventory_sku AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_batch.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_batch.location_code AS location_code,
    inventory_batch.material_code AS material_code,
    SUM(inventory_batch.available_qty) AS available_qty,
    SUM(inventory_batch.duplicate_batch) AS duplicate_batch
  FROM inventory_batch AS inventory_batch
  GROUP BY
    inventory_batch.location_type,
    inventory_batch.location_code,
    inventory_batch.material_code
), shortage_source AS (SELECT
  CAST(CONCAT(
    SUBSTRING(s.month_date, 1, 4),
    '-',
    SUBSTRING(s.month_date, 5, 2),
    '-',
    SUBSTRING(s.month_date, 7, 2)
  ) AS DATE) AS stat_date,
  d.location_type AS location_type,
  d.location_code AS location_code,
  d.location_name AS location_name,
  d.belong_base AS belong_base,
  d.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
  d.material_code AS material_code,
  d.material_name AS material_name,
  a.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name,
  a.material_group_name AS material_group_name,
  d.demand_qty AS demand_qty,
  d.allocated_qty AS allocated_qty,
  d.remaining_qty AS remaining_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN d.input_invalid = 0
    AND COALESCE(i.duplicate_batch, 0) = 0
    AND NOT s.month_date IS NULL
    THEN COALESCE(i.available_qty, 0)
  END AS available_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN d.input_invalid = 0
    AND COALESCE(i.duplicate_batch, 0) = 0
    AND NOT s.month_date IS NULL
    THEN CASE
      WHEN d.remaining_qty - COALESCE(i.available_qty, 0) > 0
      THEN d.remaining_qty - COALESCE(i.available_qty, 0)
      ELSE 0
    END
  END AS shortage_qty,
  d.source_row_count AS source_row_count,
  d.order_sku_count AS order_sku_count,
  CASE
    WHEN d.input_invalid <> 0
    OR COALESCE(i.duplicate_batch, 0) <> 0
    OR s.month_date IS NULL
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS invalid_sku,
  CASE
    WHEN d.order_sku_count > 0
    AND i.material_code IS NULL
    AND d.input_invalid = 0
    AND NOT s.month_date IS NULL
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS absent_inventory_sku
FROM complete_demand AS d
CROSS JOIN latest_inventory AS s
LEFT JOIN inventory_sku AS i
  ON d.location_type = i.location_type
  AND d.location_code = i.location_code
  AND d.material_code = i.material_code
LEFT JOIN material_attributes AS a
  ON d.material_code = a.material_code), order_presence AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_order_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS present FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS probe_order LIMIT 1) AS order_probe
 ), filtered AS (
 SELECT r.stat_date AS snapshot_date, r.location_type AS location_type, r.location_code AS location_code, r.location_name AS location_name, r.belong_base AS base, r.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, r.material_code AS sku, r.material_name AS material_name, r.product_categ_name AS category, r.material_group_name AS material_group, r.demand_qty AS demand, r.allocated_qty AS allocated, r.remaining_qty AS remaining, r.available_qty AS available, r.shortage_qty AS shortage,
 CASE WHEN p.source_order_count=0 THEN 1 ELSE r.invalid_sku END AS invalid
 FROM shortage_source AS r CROSS JOIN order_presence AS p
 WHERE (:gea_p1 IS NULL OR r.belong_base=:gea_p1)
 AND (:gea_p2 IS NULL OR r.warehouseid=:gea_p2)
 AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR r.material_code=:gea_p3)
 AND (:gea_p6 IS NULL OR r.product_categ_name=:gea_p6) AND r.location_type = '分仓'
 AND r.material_code IN (:gea_p7)
)
SELECT f.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, f.location_type AS location_type, f.base AS base, f.sku AS sku, CASE WHEN COUNT(f.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(f.demand) END AS demand, CASE WHEN COUNT(f.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(f.allocated) END AS allocated, CASE WHEN COUNT(f.remaining)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(f.remaining) END AS remaining, CASE WHEN SUM(f.invalid)>0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.available) END AS available, CASE WHEN SUM(f.invalid)>0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.shortage) END AS shortage, SUM(f.invalid) AS invalid FROM filtered AS f GROUP BY f.snapshot_date, f.location_type, f.base, f.sku ORDER BY f.snapshot_date, f.location_type, f.base, f.sku

current-shortage.skus.notes: 仅统一GEA受控SQL；复用已验证三层逻辑和11种状态含创建，短拨调账同步层已排除；无日期截断；当前状态不可重建历史；可用库存只扣一次；跨SKU不抵消。

batch-age.groups.title: 批次货龄结构
batch-age.groups.notes: 批次生产日期计算货龄；正库存有效批次数量加权，未知货龄单列，不用最大值冒充平均值。FIFO在仓库/SKU内扣近30日正向发货日均×窗口，按SKU截零后汇总。基地未来7/14日为新增跨60天风险，排除当前60+。全链未来7/14日为基地>60/分仓>=90的期末风险量。不以其他SKU库存或销量抵消。

request.sql:
WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND (:gea_p2 = FALSE OR b.belong_base IN (:gea_p3)) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR b.material_code = :gea_p5)
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.belong_base AS belong_base, d.material_name AS material_name,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day >= 1 AND d.production_day <= CASE WHEN d.production_month=2 THEN CASE WHEN (d.production_year-4*FLOOR(d.production_year/4.0)=0 AND (d.production_year-100*FLOOR(d.production_year/100.0)<>0 OR d.production_year-400*FLOOR(d.production_year/400.0)=0)) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END WHEN d.production_month IN (4,6,9,11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), batch_skus AS (
 SELECT a.month_date AS month_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),'')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty,0)) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty,0)) AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty,0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty,0)) AS freeze_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_weight_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty*a.age_days ELSE 0 END) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.live_qty>0 AND a.age_days IS NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_age_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS max_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age0_30,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_40,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age41_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 30 AND a.age_days <= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 AND a.age_days <= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age61_90,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 AND a.age_days < 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_89,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 AND a.age_days < 120 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_119,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS overaged_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 53 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 46 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future14_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 60) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 90) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk_current,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 53) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 83) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 46) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 76) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk14_candidates
 FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date,a.warehouseid,a.material_code
), batch_names AS (
 SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid,n.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group
 FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n
 INNER JOIN batch_skus AS b ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 GROUP BY n.warehouseid,n.material_code
), batch_sales AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse AS warehouseid,s.material_code AS material_code,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.act_dl_qty>0 THEN s.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END)/30.0 AS daily_movement
 FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS s
 WHERE s.act_ship_date>=:gea_p6 AND s.act_ship_date<:gea_p7
 AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR s.warehouse=:gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR s.material_code=:gea_p5)
 GROUP BY s.warehouse,s.material_code
), batch_facts AS (
 SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid,b.belong_base AS belong_base,b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
 b.material_code AS material_code,b.material_name AS material_name,
 COALESCE(n.category,'未分类') AS product_categ_name,n.material_group AS material_group_name,
 b.available_qty AS available_qty,b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty,b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,b.total_qty AS total_qty,b.age_weight_qty AS age_weight_qty,b.weighted_age AS weighted_age,
 b.unknown_age_qty AS unknown_age_qty,b.max_age AS max_age,
 b.age0_30 AS age0_30, b.age31_40 AS age31_40, b.age41_60 AS age41_60, b.age60_plus AS age60_plus, b.age31_60 AS age31_60, b.age61_90 AS age61_90, b.age90_plus AS age90_plus, b.age60_89 AS age60_89, b.age90_119 AS age90_119, b.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, b.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, b.risk_current AS risk_current,
 COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) AS daily_movement,
 (CASE WHEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future7,
 (CASE WHEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future14,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk7,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk14
 FROM batch_skus AS b LEFT JOIN batch_names AS n ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 LEFT JOIN batch_sales AS s ON b.warehouseid=s.warehouseid AND b.material_code=s.material_code
 WHERE (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR COALESCE(n.category,'未分类')=:gea_p8)
 AND (:gea_p12 IS NULL OR b.material_code LIKE :gea_p12 OR b.material_name LIKE :gea_p12)
), batch_groups AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END AS level,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END AS warehouseid,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.belong_base)=1 THEN MAX(b.belong_base) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.warehouse_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_group_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name,
 COUNT(*) AS row_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN b.age_weight_qty>0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS age_valid_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.overaged_qty>0 THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END) AS is_overaged_sku_count, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_low_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_high_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_code) AS sku_count,
 SUM(b.available_qty) AS available_qty,SUM(b.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty,SUM(b.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty,CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AS stat_date,MAX(b.max_age) AS age_days,SUM(b.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(b.age_weight_qty) AS age_weight_qty,SUM(b.weighted_age) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(b.unknown_age_qty) AS unknown_age_qty,MAX(b.max_age) AS max_age,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)>0 THEN SUM(b.weighted_age)*1.0/SUM(b.age_weight_qty) ELSE NULL END AS average_age,
 SUM(b.age0_30) AS age0_30, SUM(b.age31_40) AS age31_40, SUM(b.age41_60) AS age41_60, SUM(b.age60_plus) AS age60_plus, SUM(b.age31_60) AS age31_60, SUM(b.age61_90) AS age61_90, SUM(b.age90_plus) AS age90_plus, SUM(b.age60_89) AS age60_89, SUM(b.age90_119) AS age90_119, SUM(b.overaged_qty) AS overaged_qty, SUM(b.stagnant_qty) AS stagnant_qty, SUM(b.risk_current) AS risk_current,
 SUM(b.daily_movement) AS daily_movement,SUM(b.future7) AS future7,SUM(b.future14) AS future14,
 SUM(b.projected_risk7) AS projected_risk7,SUM(b.projected_risk14) AS projected_risk14,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.daily_movement)>0 THEN SUM(b.total_qty)*1.0/SUM(b.daily_movement) ELSE NULL END AS historical_turnover,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)=0 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(b.stagnant_qty)>0 THEN '滞库' WHEN SUM(b.overaged_qty)>0 THEN '预警' ELSE '正常' END AS warning
 FROM batch_facts AS b
 GROUP BY CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END
) SELECT g.row_count AS row_count, g.age_valid_count AS age_valid_count, g.is_overaged_sku_count AS is_overaged_sku_count, g.is_low_stock_sku_count AS is_low_stock_sku_count, g.is_high_stock_sku_count AS is_high_stock_sku_count, g.conflicting_stock_flag_skus AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus, g.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at, g.available_qty AS available_qty, g.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, g.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, g.stat_date AS stat_date, g.age_days AS age_days, g.level AS level, g.warehouseid AS warehouseid, g.material_code AS material_code, g.belong_base AS belong_base, g.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, g.material_name AS material_name, g.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, g.material_group_name AS material_group_name, g.sku_count AS sku_count, g.total_qty AS total_qty, g.age_weight_qty AS age_weight_qty, g.weighted_age AS weighted_age, g.unknown_age_qty AS unknown_age_qty, g.max_age AS max_age, g.average_age AS average_age, g.age0_30 AS age0_30, g.age31_40 AS age31_40, g.age41_60 AS age41_60, g.age60_plus AS age60_plus, g.age31_60 AS age31_60, g.age61_90 AS age61_90, g.age90_plus AS age90_plus, g.age60_89 AS age60_89, g.age90_119 AS age90_119, g.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, g.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, g.risk_current AS risk_current, g.daily_movement AS daily_movement, g.future7 AS future7, g.future14 AS future14, g.projected_risk7 AS projected_risk7, g.projected_risk14 AS projected_risk14, g.historical_turnover AS historical_turnover, g.warning AS warning FROM batch_groups AS g WHERE (:gea_p15 IS NULL OR g.warning = :gea_p15) ORDER BY CASE WHEN :gea_p13='total_qty' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN g.total_qty ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='total_qty' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN g.total_qty ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='age60_plus' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN g.age60_plus ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='age60_plus' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN g.age60_plus ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='average_age' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN g.average_age ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='average_age' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN g.average_age ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='daily_movement' AND :gea_p14='asc' THEN g.daily_movement ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p13='daily_movement' AND :gea_p14='desc' THEN g.daily_movement ELSE NULL END DESC, g.level,g.warehouseid,g.material_code LIMIT :gea_p10 OFFSET :gea_p11
