gea_p7.format: YYYYMMDD

batch-age.count.title: 批次货龄结构
batch-age.count.notes: 批次生产日期计算货龄；正库存有效批次数量加权，未知货龄单列，不用最大值冒充平均值。FIFO在仓库/SKU内扣近30日正向发货日均×窗口，按SKU截零后汇总。基地未来7/14日为新增跨60天风险，排除当前60+。全链未来7/14日为基地>60/分仓>=90的期末风险量。不以其他SKU库存或销量抵消。

request.sql:
WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND (:gea_p2 = FALSE OR b.belong_base IN (:gea_p3)) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR b.material_code = :gea_p5)
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.belong_base AS belong_base, d.material_name AS material_name,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day >= 1 AND d.production_day <= CASE WHEN d.production_month=2 THEN CASE WHEN (d.production_year-4*FLOOR(d.production_year/4.0)=0 AND (d.production_year-100*FLOOR(d.production_year/100.0)<>0 OR d.production_year-400*FLOOR(d.production_year/400.0)=0)) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END WHEN d.production_month IN (4,6,9,11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), batch_skus AS (
 SELECT a.month_date AS month_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),'')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty,0)) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty,0)) AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty,0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty,0)) AS freeze_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_weight_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty*a.age_days ELSE 0 END) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.live_qty>0 AND a.age_days IS NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_age_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS max_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age0_30,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_40,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age41_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 30 AND a.age_days <= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 AND a.age_days <= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age61_90,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 AND a.age_days < 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_89,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 AND a.age_days < 120 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_119,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS overaged_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 53 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 46 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future14_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 60) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 90) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk_current,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 53) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 83) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 46) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 76) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk14_candidates
 FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date,a.warehouseid,a.material_code
), batch_names AS (
 SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid,n.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group
 FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n
 INNER JOIN batch_skus AS b ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 GROUP BY n.warehouseid,n.material_code
), batch_sales AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse AS warehouseid,s.material_code AS material_code,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.act_dl_qty>0 THEN s.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END)/30.0 AS daily_movement
 FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS s
 WHERE s.act_ship_date>=:gea_p6 AND s.act_ship_date<:gea_p7
 AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR s.warehouse=:gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR s.material_code=:gea_p5)
 GROUP BY s.warehouse,s.material_code
), batch_facts AS (
 SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid,b.belong_base AS belong_base,b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
 b.material_code AS material_code,b.material_name AS material_name,
 COALESCE(n.category,'未分类') AS product_categ_name,n.material_group AS material_group_name,
 b.available_qty AS available_qty,b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty,b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,b.total_qty AS total_qty,b.age_weight_qty AS age_weight_qty,b.weighted_age AS weighted_age,
 b.unknown_age_qty AS unknown_age_qty,b.max_age AS max_age,
 b.age0_30 AS age0_30, b.age31_40 AS age31_40, b.age41_60 AS age41_60, b.age60_plus AS age60_plus, b.age31_60 AS age31_60, b.age61_90 AS age61_90, b.age90_plus AS age90_plus, b.age60_89 AS age60_89, b.age90_119 AS age90_119, b.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, b.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, b.risk_current AS risk_current,
 COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) AS daily_movement,
 (CASE WHEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future7,
 (CASE WHEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future14,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk7,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk14
 FROM batch_skus AS b LEFT JOIN batch_names AS n ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 LEFT JOIN batch_sales AS s ON b.warehouseid=s.warehouseid AND b.material_code=s.material_code
 WHERE (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR COALESCE(n.category,'未分类')=:gea_p8)
 AND (:gea_p12 IS NULL OR b.material_code LIKE :gea_p12 OR b.material_name LIKE :gea_p12)
), batch_groups AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END AS level,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END AS warehouseid,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.belong_base)=1 THEN MAX(b.belong_base) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.warehouse_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_group_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name,
 COUNT(*) AS row_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN b.age_weight_qty>0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS age_valid_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.overaged_qty>0 THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END) AS is_overaged_sku_count, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_low_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_high_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_code) AS sku_count,
 SUM(b.available_qty) AS available_qty,SUM(b.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty,SUM(b.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty,CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AS stat_date,MAX(b.max_age) AS age_days,SUM(b.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(b.age_weight_qty) AS age_weight_qty,SUM(b.weighted_age) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(b.unknown_age_qty) AS unknown_age_qty,MAX(b.max_age) AS max_age,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)>0 THEN SUM(b.weighted_age)*1.0/SUM(b.age_weight_qty) ELSE NULL END AS average_age,
 SUM(b.age0_30) AS age0_30, SUM(b.age31_40) AS age31_40, SUM(b.age41_60) AS age41_60, SUM(b.age60_plus) AS age60_plus, SUM(b.age31_60) AS age31_60, SUM(b.age61_90) AS age61_90, SUM(b.age90_plus) AS age90_plus, SUM(b.age60_89) AS age60_89, SUM(b.age90_119) AS age90_119, SUM(b.overaged_qty) AS overaged_qty, SUM(b.stagnant_qty) AS stagnant_qty, SUM(b.risk_current) AS risk_current,
 SUM(b.daily_movement) AS daily_movement,SUM(b.future7) AS future7,SUM(b.future14) AS future14,
 SUM(b.projected_risk7) AS projected_risk7,SUM(b.projected_risk14) AS projected_risk14,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.daily_movement)>0 THEN SUM(b.total_qty)*1.0/SUM(b.daily_movement) ELSE NULL END AS historical_turnover,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)=0 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(b.stagnant_qty)>0 THEN '滞库' WHEN SUM(b.overaged_qty)>0 THEN '预警' ELSE '正常' END AS warning
 FROM batch_facts AS b
 GROUP BY CASE WHEN :gea_p9='base' THEN b.belong_base WHEN :gea_p9='category' THEN b.product_categ_name ELSE b.material_code END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END,
 CASE WHEN :gea_p9 IN ('sku','detail') THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM batch_groups AS g WHERE (:gea_p15 IS NULL OR g.warning = :gea_p15)

batch-age.atomic.title: 批次货龄结构
batch-age.atomic.notes: 批次生产日期计算货龄；正库存有效批次数量加权，未知货龄单列，不用最大值冒充平均值。FIFO在仓库/SKU内扣近30日正向发货日均×窗口，按SKU截零后汇总。基地未来7/14日为新增跨60天风险，排除当前60+。全链未来7/14日为基地>60/分仓>=90的期末风险量。不以其他SKU库存或销量抵消。

request.sql:
WITH inventory_batch_dates AS (
SELECT b.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code,
 b.month_date AS month_date,
 b.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, b.belong_base AS belong_base, b.material_name AS material_name,
 b.live_qty AS live_qty, b.available_qty AS available_qty,
 b.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, b.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_year,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_month,
 CAST(SUBSTRING(b.month_date, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS snapshot_day,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_year,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_month,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE NULL END AS production_day
FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND (:gea_p2 = FALSE OR b.belong_base IN (:gea_p3)) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR b.warehouseid = :gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR b.material_code = :gea_p5)
), inventory_batch_ages AS (
SELECT d.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify, d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code,
 d.month_date AS month_date,
 d.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, d.belong_base AS belong_base, d.material_name AS material_name,
 d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty,
 d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty,
 CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0
 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day >= 1 AND d.production_day <= CASE WHEN d.production_month=2 THEN CASE WHEN (d.production_year-4*FLOOR(d.production_year/4.0)=0 AND (d.production_year-100*FLOOR(d.production_year/100.0)<>0 OR d.production_year-400*FLOOR(d.production_year/400.0)=0)) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END WHEN d.production_month IN (4,6,9,11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END
 AND (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) >= (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) - (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) ELSE NULL END AS age_days
FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d
), batch_skus AS (
 SELECT a.month_date AS month_date, a.warehouseid AS warehouseid, a.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.belong_base),'')) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.warehouse_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.material_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty,0)) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty,0)) AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty,0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty,0)) AS freeze_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_weight_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days IS NOT NULL THEN a.live_qty*a.age_days ELSE 0 END) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.live_qty>0 AND a.age_days IS NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_age_qty,
 MAX(a.age_days) AS max_age,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age0_30,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_40,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age41_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 30 AND a.age_days <= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age31_60,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 60 AND a.age_days <= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age61_90,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days > 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_plus,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 AND a.age_days < 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age60_89,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 AND a.age_days < 120 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age90_119,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS overaged_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 53 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 46 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS future14_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 60) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 90) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk_current,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 53) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 83) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk7_candidates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN (a.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND a.age_days > 46) OR (a.warehouse_classify = '20' AND a.age_days >= 76) THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS risk14_candidates
 FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date,a.warehouseid,a.material_code
), batch_names AS (
 SELECT n.warehouseid AS warehouseid,n.material_code AS material_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.product_categ_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS category,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(n.material_group_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS material_group
 FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS n
 INNER JOIN batch_skus AS b ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 GROUP BY n.warehouseid,n.material_code
), batch_sales AS (
 SELECT s.warehouse AS warehouseid,s.material_code AS material_code,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.act_dl_qty>0 THEN s.act_dl_qty ELSE 0 END)/30.0 AS daily_movement
 FROM agents_scm_cust_deliv_daily_di AS s
 WHERE s.act_ship_date>=:gea_p6 AND s.act_ship_date<:gea_p7
 AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR s.warehouse=:gea_p4) AND (:gea_p5 IS NULL OR s.material_code=:gea_p5)
 GROUP BY s.warehouse,s.material_code
), batch_facts AS (

 b.unknown_age_qty AS unknown_age_qty,b.max_age AS max_age,
 b.age0_30 AS age0_30, b.age31_40 AS age31_40, b.age41_60 AS age41_60, b.age60_plus AS age60_plus, b.age31_60 AS age31_60, b.age61_90 AS age61_90, b.age90_plus AS age90_plus, b.age60_89 AS age60_89, b.age90_119 AS age90_119, b.overaged_qty AS overaged_qty, b.stagnant_qty AS stagnant_qty, b.risk_current AS risk_current,
 COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) AS daily_movement,
 (CASE WHEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future7,
 (CASE WHEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.future14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END)-(CASE WHEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.age60_plus-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS future14,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk7_candidates-7*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk7,
 (CASE WHEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) > 0 THEN b.risk14_candidates-14*COALESCE(s.daily_movement,0) ELSE 0 END) AS projected_risk14
 FROM batch_skus AS b LEFT JOIN batch_names AS n ON b.warehouseid=n.warehouseid AND b.material_code=n.material_code
 LEFT JOIN batch_sales AS s ON b.warehouseid=s.warehouseid AND b.material_code=s.material_code
 WHERE (:gea_p8 IS NULL OR COALESCE(n.category,'未分类')=:gea_p8)

), batch_groups AS (

 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.belong_base)=1 THEN MAX(b.belong_base) ELSE NULL END AS belong_base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.warehouse_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name,

 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_group_name)=1 THEN MAX(b.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group_name,
 COUNT(*) AS row_count,COUNT(CASE WHEN b.age_weight_qty>0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS age_valid_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.overaged_qty>0 THEN b.material_code ELSE NULL END) AS is_overaged_sku_count, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_low_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS is_high_stock_sku_count,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS source_updated_at,COUNT(DISTINCT b.material_code) AS sku_count,
 SUM(b.available_qty) AS available_qty,SUM(b.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty,SUM(b.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty,CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AS stat_date,MAX(b.max_age) AS age_days,SUM(b.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(b.age_weight_qty) AS age_weight_qty,SUM(b.weighted_age) AS weighted_age,
 SUM(b.unknown_age_qty) AS unknown_age_qty,MAX(b.max_age) AS max_age,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)>0 THEN SUM(b.weighted_age)*1.0/SUM(b.age_weight_qty) ELSE NULL END AS average_age,
 SUM(b.age0_30) AS age0_30, SUM(b.age31_40) AS age31_40, SUM(b.age41_60) AS age41_60, SUM(b.age60_plus) AS age60_plus, SUM(b.age31_60) AS age31_60, SUM(b.age61_90) AS age61_90, SUM(b.age90_plus) AS age90_plus, SUM(b.age60_89) AS age60_89, SUM(b.age90_119) AS age90_119, SUM(b.overaged_qty) AS overaged_qty, SUM(b.stagnant_qty) AS stagnant_qty, SUM(b.risk_current) AS risk_current,
 SUM(b.daily_movement) AS daily_movement,SUM(b.future7) AS future7,SUM(b.future14) AS future14,
 SUM(b.projected_risk7) AS projected_risk7,SUM(b.projected_risk14) AS projected_risk14,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.daily_movement)>0 THEN SUM(b.total_qty)*1.0/SUM(b.daily_movement) ELSE NULL END AS historical_turnover,
 CASE WHEN SUM(b.age_weight_qty)=0 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(b.stagnant_qty)>0 THEN '滞库' WHEN SUM(b.overaged_qty)>0 THEN '预警' ELSE '正常' END AS warning
 FROM batch_facts AS b

 CASE WHEN :gea_p9='detail' THEN b.warehouseid ELSE NULL END,

), batch_page AS (SELECT g.row_count AS row_count, g.age_valid_count AS age_valid_count, g.is_overaged_sku_count AS is_overaged_sku_count, g.is_low_stock_sku_count AS is_low_stock_sku_count, g.is_high_stock_sku_count AS is_high_stock_sku_count, g.conflicting_stock_flag_skus AS conflicting_stock_flag_skus, g.source_updated_at AS source_updated_at, g.available_qty AS available_qty, g.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, g.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, g.stat_date AS stat_date, g.age_days AS age_days, g.level AS level, g.warehouseid AS warehouseid, g.material_code AS material_code, g.belong_base AS belong_base, g.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, g.material_name AS material_name, g.product_categ_name AS product_categ_name, g.material_group_name AS material_group_name, agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid), inventory_rows AS (SELECT i.month_date AS month_date, i.warehouseid AS warehouseid, i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, i.belong_base AS belong_base, location_type, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), point_location_candidates AS (SELECT inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type, inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code, MAX(inventory_rows.location_name) AS location_name, MAX(inventory_rows.belong_base) AS belong_base, CASE WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓' THEN inventory_rows WHERE NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY inventory_rows.pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type, inventory_rows.location_code), point_locations AS (SELECT point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type, MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates GROUP BY point_location_candidates.pickup_point HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1), current_order_lines AS (SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.cust_code AS cust_code, o.qtyallocated AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty < o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o WHERE o.detailstatus = 10 AND o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波', '组波中', '组波完成', '组波失败', '提交成功', '提交中', '提交失败', '上传验证', '人工释放占用', '撤回待改单', '创建') AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL), current_open_orders AS (SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code, l.pickup_point AS COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL')) ELSE m.location_code END AS location_code, MAX(COALESCE(m.location_name, o.pickup_point_name)) AS location_name, MAX(COALESCE(m.belong_base, o.belong_base)) AS belong_base, MAX(m.warehouseid) AS warehouseid, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(o.material_name), '')) END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.demand_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.demand_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.demand_qty) END AS demand_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.allocated_qty) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(o.allocated_qty) >= 0 THEN SUM(o.allocated_qty) o.cust_code, o.material_code, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN '待映射' ELSE m.location_type END, CASE WHEN m.pickup_point IS NULL THEN CONCAT('unmapped:', COALESCE(o.pickup_point, 'NULL')) ELSE m.location_code END), fc_order_keys AS (SELECT o.location_type AS location_type, o.warehouseid AS warehouseid, o.material_code AS material_code FROM eligible_order_sku AS o GROUP BY o.location_type, o.warehouseid, o.material_code), source_records AS (SELECT t.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_name) ELSE NULL END AS COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_future30_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_future30_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_transfer_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_transfer_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_onway_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_onway_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_prepare_qty) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_prepare_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.stat_month) ELSE NULL END AS stat_month, '分仓同步表' AS plan_source, CAST(NULL AS d.production_day) THEN (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.demand_qty, 0) END AS current_order_demand, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.allocated_qty, 0) END AS current_order_allocated, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.remaining_qty, 0) END AS current_order_remaining, CASE WHEN op.source_order_count = 0 OR co.invalid_sku <> 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(co.shortage_qty, 0) END AS current_order_shortage, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) AS expected_month_end_qty, CASE WHEN pp.current_count <> 1 OR agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid), inventory_rows AS (SELECT i.month_date AS month_date, i.warehouseid AS warehouseid, i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, i.belong_base AS belong_base, location_type, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code, CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')), point_location_candidates AS (SELECT inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type, inventory_rows WHERE NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL GROUP BY inventory_rows.pickup_point, inventory_rows.location_type, inventory_rows.location_code), point_locations AS (SELECT point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point, MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type, MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates GROUP BY point_location_candidates.pickup_point HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1 AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1), current_order_lines AS (SELECT o.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, o.cust_code AS cust_code, o.material_code AS material_code, o.material_name AS material_name, o.pickup_point AS pickup_point, o.pickup_point_name AS pickup_point_name, o.belong_base AS belong_base, o.qtyordered AS demand_qty, o.qtyallocated AS allocated_qty, CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty < o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o WHERE o.detailstatus = 10 AND o.bizflowstatus IN ('等待组波', '组波中', '组波完成', '组波失败', '提交成功', '提交中', '提交失败', '上传验证', '人工释放占用', '撤回待改单', '创建') AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NULL), current_open_orders AS (SELECT l.cust_order_no AS cust_order_no, l.cust_code AS cust_code, l.pickup_point AS COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.warehouse_transfer_qty) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_transfer_qty, CASE = 1 THEN MAX(t.stat_month) ELSE NULL END AS stat_month, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM agents_scm_warehouse_transfer_plan_data_d AS t WHERE t.stat_month = SUBSTRING(REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p2300 AS BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 2) AS INT) ELSE NULL END AS production_month, CASE WHEN LENGTH(b.prod_date) >= 10 AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 5, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 8, 1) = '-' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 1, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 2, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 3, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 4, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 6, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 7, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' AND SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 10, 1) BETWEEN '0' AND '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING(b.prod_date, 9, 2) AS INT) ELSE NULL END AS production_day FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')), inventory_batch_ordinals AS (SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code, d.month_date AS month_date, d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty, d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, d.production_year AS production_year, d.production_month AS production_month, d.production_day AS production_day, (365 * (d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.snapshot_year - CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.snapshot_month + CASE WHEN d.snapshot_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.snapshot_day) AS snapshot_ordinal, (365 * (d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 4.0) - FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 100.0) + FLOOR((d.production_year - CASE WHEN d.production_month <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 400.0) + FLOOR((153 * (d.production_month + CASE WHEN d.production_month > 2 THEN -3 ELSE 9 END) + 2) / 5.0) + d.production_day) AS production_ordinal FROM inventory_batch_dates AS d), inventory_batch_ages AS (SELECT d.warehouseid AS warehouseid, d.material_code AS material_code, d.month_date AS month_date, d.live_qty AS live_qty, d.available_qty AS available_qty, d.pack_unit_qty AS pack_unit_qty, d.freeze_qty AS freeze_qty, CASE WHEN d.live_qty > 0 AND d.production_year > 0 AND d.production_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND d.production_day >= 1 AND d.production_day <= CASE WHEN d.production_month = 2 THEN CASE WHEN (d.production_year - 4 * FLOOR(d.production_year / 4.0) = 0 AND (d.production_year - 100 * FLOOR(d.production_year / 100.0) <> 0 OR d.production_year - 400 * FLOOR(d.production_year / 400.0) = 0)) THEN 29 ELSE 28 END WHEN d.production_month IN (4, 6, 9, 11) THEN 30 ELSE 31 END AND d.snapshot_ordinal >= d.production_ordinal THEN d.snapshot_ordinal - d.production_ordinal ELSE NULL END AS age_days FROM inventory_batch_ordinals AS d), inventory_batch_totals AS (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a.live_qty, 0)) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.available_qty, 0)) AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.pack_unit_qty, 0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(a.freeze_qty, 0)) AS freeze_qty, MAX(a.age_days) AS age_days, SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 60 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS overaged_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN a.age_days >= 90 THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT a.age_days IS NULL THEN a.live_qty * a.age_days ELSE 0 END) AS weighted_age_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT a.age_days IS NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_weight_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN a.live_qty > 0 AND a.age_days IS NULL THEN a.live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_age_qty FROM inventory_batch_ages AS a GROUP BY a.month_date, a.warehouseid, a.material_code) SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, SUM(r.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(r.available_qty) AS available_qty, SUM(r.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(r.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty, MAX(r.age_days) AS max_age, MAX(r.age_days) AS base_max_age, SUM(CASE WHEN r.age_days >= 0 AND r.total_qty >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age_valid_count, SUM(r.overaged_qty) AS overaged_qty, SUM(r.stagnant_qty) AS stagnant_qty, COALESCE(SUM(r.weighted_age_sum), 0) AS weighted_age_sum, COALESCE(SUM(r.age_weight_qty), 0) AS age_weight_qty, COALESCE(SUM(r.unknown_age_qty), 0) AS unknown_age_qty, SUM(r.weighted_age_sum) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(r.age_weight_qty), 0) AS average_age FROM inventory_batch_totals AS r

WITH quantities AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouseid, b.material_code AS material_code, SUM(COALESCE(b.live_qty, 0)) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(b.available_qty, 0)) AS available_qty, SUM(COALESCE(b.pack_unit_qty, 0)) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(COALESCE(b.freeze_qty, 0)) AS freeze_qty FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date = REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') GROUP BY b.warehouseid,b.material_code) SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, SUM(q.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(q.available_qty) AS available_qty, SUM(q.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty, SUM(q.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty FROM quantities AS q

WITH latest AS (
 SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(8)) AS base_day,
 MAX(CASE WHEN b.warehouse_classify='20' AND NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid),'') IS NOT NULL THEN b.month_date ELSE NULL END) AS branch_day
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b
 WHERE b.warehouse_classify='20' AND b.month_date<=REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)),'-','')
 AND LENGTH(b.month_date)=8 AND SUBSTRING(b.month_date,5,2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12' AND SUBSTRING(b.month_date,7,2) BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
), pools AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN b.warehouse_classify='20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type,
 b.month_date AS day_key, b.warehouseid AS warehouseid,b.material_code AS material_code,
 SUM(COALESCE(b.live_qty,0)) AS total_qty,SUM(COALESCE(b.available_qty,0)) AS available_qty,
 SUM(COALESCE(b.pack_unit_qty,0)) AS pack_unit_qty,SUM(COALESCE(b.freeze_qty,0)) AS freeze_qty
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b CROSS JOIN latest AS l
 WHERE b.warehouse_classify='20' AND ((b.warehouse_classify='20' AND b.month_date=l.branch_day) OR (b.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND b.month_date=l.base_day))
 GROUP BY CASE WHEN b.warehouse_classify='20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END,b.month_date,b.warehouseid,b.material_code
) SELECT p.location_type AS location_type,CONCAT(SUBSTRING(p.day_key,1,4),'-',SUBSTRING(p.day_key,5,2),'-',SUBSTRING(p.day_key,7,2)) AS snapshot_date,
 COUNT(*) AS row_count,SUM(p.total_qty) AS total_qty,SUM(p.available_qty) AS available_qty,SUM(p.pack_unit_qty) AS pack_unit_qty,SUM(p.freeze_qty) AS freeze_qty
 FROM pools AS p GROUP BY p.location_type,p.day_key ORDER BY p.location_type

base-production.days.title: 基地未来七日排程
base-production.days.notes: 用户确认排程数量已统一为件，沿用1件=1箱，不按单位标签重复换算。使用基本完成日期，逐生产订单SKU校验；负数、重复和缺数保留未知，不拿历史MES实绩代替。

request.sql:
WITH plant_bases AS (
 SELECT b.plant AS plant,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(b.belong_base),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(b.belong_base),'')) ELSE NULL END AS base
 FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND b.plant IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.plant
), production_orders AS (
 SELECT p.order_no AS order_no,p.material_code AS material_code,p.factory_code AS factory_code,p.base_finish_day AS day,
 COALESCE(CASE p.factory_code WHEN '3001' THEN '郑州' WHEN '5001' THEN '遂平' WHEN '9001' THEN '遂平' WHEN '6001' THEN '华东' WHEN '7001' THEN '华南' WHEN '8001' THEN '西南' ELSE NULL END,m.base) AS base,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(p.order_qty) ELSE NULL END AS quantity,COUNT(*) AS source_rows
 FROM agents_prod_schedule_detail_d AS p LEFT JOIN plant_bases AS m ON m.plant=p.factory_code
 WHERE p.base_finish_day IN (:gea_p700,:gea_p701,:gea_p702,:gea_p703,:gea_p704,:gea_p705,:gea_p706)
 AND (:gea_p2=FALSE OR COALESCE(CASE p.factory_code WHEN '3001' THEN '郑州' WHEN '5001' THEN '遂平' WHEN '9001' THEN '遂平' WHEN '6001' THEN '华东' WHEN '7001' THEN '华南' WHEN '8001' THEN '西南' ELSE NULL END,m.base) IN (:gea_p3)) AND (:gea_p4 IS NULL OR p.material_code=:gea_p4)
 GROUP BY p.order_no,p.material_code,p.factory_code,p.base_finish_day,COALESCE(CASE p.factory_code WHEN '3001' THEN '郑州' WHEN '5001' THEN '遂平' WHEN '9001' THEN '遂平' WHEN '6001' THEN '华东' WHEN '7001' THEN '华南' WHEN '8001' THEN '西南' ELSE NULL END,m.base)
) SELECT p.base AS base,CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p700 AND (p.quantity IS NULL OR p.quantity<0 OR p.source_rows<>1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p700 THEN p.quantity ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS production_day_0, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p701 AND (p.quantity IS NULL OR p.quantity<0 OR p.source_rows<>1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p701 THEN p.quantity ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS production_day_1, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p702 AND (p.quantity IS NULL OR p.quantity<0 OR p.source_rows<>1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p702 THEN p.quantity ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS production_day_2, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p703 AND (p.quantity IS NULL OR p.quantity<0 OR p.source_rows<>1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p703 THEN p.quantity ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS production_day_3, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p704 AND (p.quantity IS NULL OR p.quantity<0 OR p.source_rows<>1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p704 THEN p.quantity ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS production_day_4, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p705 AND (p.quantity IS NULL OR p.quantity<0 OR p.source_rows<>1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p705 THEN p.quantity ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS production_day_5, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p706 AND (p.quantity IS NULL OR p.quantity<0 OR p.source_rows<>1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.day=:gea_p706 THEN p.quantity ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END AS production_day_6, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.quantity IS NULL OR p.quantity<0 OR p.source_rows<>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN SUM(p.quantity) ELSE NULL END AS production_total FROM production_orders AS p WHERE p.base IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.base ORDER BY p.base

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(b.month_date) AS day FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date <= REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')), warehouses AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouse_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouse_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(b.belong_base),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(b.belong_base),'')) ELSE NULL END AS base FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b INNER JOIN latest AS l ON b.month_date=l.day WHERE b.warehouse_classify='20' AND NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.warehouseid) SELECT w.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,w.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,w.base AS base FROM warehouses AS w ORDER BY w.warehouse_code LIMIT :gea_p2 OFFSET :gea_p3

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(b.month_date) AS day FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b WHERE b.warehouse_classify = '20' AND b.month_date <= REPLACE(CAST(:gea_p1 AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '')), warehouses AS (SELECT b.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouse_name),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouse_name),'')) ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(b.belong_base),''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(b.belong_base),'')) ELSE NULL END AS base FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS b INNER JOIN latest AS l ON b.month_date=l.day WHERE b.warehouse_classify='20' AND NULLIF(TRIM(b.warehouseid),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.warehouseid) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM warehouses AS w

branch-current-orders.page.title: 分仓当前未发货完成订单
branch-current-orders.page.notes: 当前有效且未关闭/作废的分仓自身订单；按实际发货件数与预期EA需求判断未发完，包含已备单和部分发货；保留同一未发完订单的已发完SKU。订单量与需求取当前执行单预期EA，订单占用取EA，实际发货取件；不使用原始包装数量或有差异的下单折合件字段。缺失数量不按0。未备量逐行max(需求-订单占用,0)，不把库存按订单重复扣减；此列表不修改三层缺货模型。

request.sql:
WITH latest_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.month_date) AS month_date
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d
  WHERE
    agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), warehouse_points AS (
  SELECT
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), ''))
    END AS pickup_point
  FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d
  GROUP BY
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid
), inventory_rows AS (
  SELECT
    i.month_date AS month_date,
    i.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
    i.belong_base AS belong_base,
    i.material_code AS material_code,
    i.material_name AS material_name,
    i.prod_date AS prod_date,
    i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,
    i.plant AS plant,
    i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,
    i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,
    i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
    i.available_qty AS available_qty,
    w.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
  INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s
    ON i.month_date = s.month_date
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w
    ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid
  WHERE
    i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), point_location_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code,
    MAX(inventory_rows.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(inventory_rows.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    CASE
      WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓'
      THEN MAX(inventory_rows.warehouseid)
    END AS warehouseid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.location_name) AS name_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.belong_base) AS base_count
  FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows
  WHERE
    NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    inventory_rows.pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code
), point_locations AS (
  SELECT
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_code) AS location_code,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid
  FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates
  GROUP BY
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1
), branch_order_lines AS (
 SELECT m.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, m.location_name AS warehouse_name,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(o.executeorderno), '')) AS order_no,
 o.cust_code AS customer_code, o.cust_name AS customer_name,
 o.material_code AS sku, o.material_name AS material_name,
 o.requireddeliverytime AS requested_at, o.header_addtime AS created_at,
 o.qtyordered AS ordered, o.qtyordered AS demand,
 o.qtyallocated AS allocated, o.delivery_qty AS shipped,
 CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.qtyallocated IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN o.qtyordered > o.qtyallocated THEN o.qtyordered-o.qtyallocated ELSE 0 END AS remaining,
 o.bizflowstatus AS order_status,
 CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty<o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped
 FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o
 INNER JOIN point_locations AS m ON o.pickup_point=m.pickup_point
 WHERE m.location_type='分仓' AND o.detailstatus=10
 AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL
 AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL
 AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NOT NULL
 AND (:gea_p1 IS NULL OR m.warehouseid=:gea_p1)
), open_orders AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, l.order_no AS order_no, l.customer_code AS customer_code
 FROM branch_order_lines AS l
 GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.order_no,l.customer_code
 HAVING MAX(l.unshipped)=1
), open_lines AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,l.order_no AS order_no,
 l.customer_code AS customer_code,l.customer_name AS customer_name,l.sku AS sku,
 l.material_name AS material_name,l.requested_at AS requested_at,l.created_at AS created_at,
 l.ordered AS ordered,l.demand AS demand,l.allocated AS allocated,l.shipped AS shipped,
 l.remaining AS remaining,l.order_status AS order_status,l.unshipped AS unshipped
 FROM branch_order_lines AS l INNER JOIN open_orders AS o
 ON l.warehouse_code=o.warehouse_code AND l.order_no=o.order_no
 AND (l.customer_code=o.customer_code OR (l.customer_code IS NULL AND o.customer_code IS NULL))
), order_groups AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,MAX(l.warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name,l.order_no AS order_no,
 l.customer_code AS customer_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_name)=1 THEN MAX(l.customer_name) ELSE NULL END AS customer_name,
 MIN(l.requested_at) AS requested_at,MIN(l.created_at) AS created_at,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.ordered)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.ordered) ELSE NULL END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.demand) ELSE NULL END AS demand,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.allocated) ELSE NULL END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.shipped) ELSE NULL END AS shipped,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.remaining)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.remaining) ELSE NULL END AS remaining,
 COUNT(DISTINCT l.sku) AS sku_count,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) AND COUNT(l.allocated)=COUNT(*) AND SUM(l.demand)>0
 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.allocated>l.demand THEN l.demand WHEN l.allocated<0 THEN 0 ELSE l.allocated END)*1.0/SUM(l.demand) ELSE NULL END AS satisfaction,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_status)=1 THEN MAX(l.order_status) ELSE NULL END AS order_status
 FROM open_lines AS l
 WHERE (:gea_p2 IS NULL OR l.customer_code=:gea_p2)
 AND (:gea_p3 IS NULL OR LOWER(l.order_no) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p3) OR LOWER(l.customer_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p3))
 GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.order_no,l.customer_code
 HAVING (:gea_p4=FALSE OR SUM(l.remaining)>0)
), page_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_scope_total FROM order_groups AS g), page_rows AS (
 SELECT g.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, g.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, g.order_no AS order_no, g.customer_code AS customer_code, g.customer_name AS customer_name, g.requested_at AS requested_at, g.created_at AS created_at, g.ordered AS ordered, g.demand AS demand, g.allocated AS allocated, g.shipped AS shipped, g.remaining AS remaining, g.sku_count AS sku_count, g.satisfaction AS satisfaction, g.order_status AS order_status,1 AS page_row_present
 FROM order_groups AS g ORDER BY g.created_at DESC,g.warehouse_code,g.order_no,g.customer_code
 LIMIT :gea_p5 OFFSET :gea_p6
)
SELECT p.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, p.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, p.order_no AS order_no, p.customer_code AS customer_code, p.customer_name AS customer_name, p.requested_at AS requested_at, p.created_at AS created_at, p.ordered AS ordered, p.demand AS demand, p.allocated AS allocated, p.shipped AS shipped, p.remaining AS remaining, p.sku_count AS sku_count, p.satisfaction AS satisfaction, p.order_status AS order_status,p.page_row_present AS page_row_present,n.page_scope_total AS page_scope_total
FROM page_count AS n LEFT JOIN page_rows AS p ON TRUE
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.warehouse_code,p.order_no,p.customer_code

WITH latest_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.month_date) AS month_date
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d
  WHERE
    agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), warehouse_points AS (
  SELECT
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), '')) = 1
      THEN MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.pickup_point), ''))
    END AS pickup_point
  FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d AS agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d
  GROUP BY
    agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d.warehouseid
), inventory_rows AS (
  SELECT
    i.month_date AS month_date,
    i.warehouseid AS warehouseid,
    i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,
    i.belong_base AS belong_base,
    i.material_code AS material_code,
    i.material_name AS material_name,
    i.prod_date AS prod_date,
    i.sap_warehouseid AS sap_warehouseid,
    i.plant AS plant,
    i.quality_batch AS quality_batch,
    i.is_good_prod AS is_good_prod,
    i.warehouse_classify AS warehouse_classify,
    i.available_qty AS available_qty,
    w.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN '分仓' ELSE '基地' END AS location_type,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouseid ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_code,
    CASE WHEN i.warehouse_classify = '20' THEN i.warehouse_name ELSE i.belong_base END AS location_name
  FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d AS i
  INNER JOIN latest_inventory AS s
    ON i.month_date = s.month_date
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_points AS w
    ON i.warehouseid = w.warehouseid
  WHERE
    i.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02', '20')
), point_location_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    inventory_rows.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type AS location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code AS location_code,
    MAX(inventory_rows.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(inventory_rows.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    CASE
      WHEN inventory_rows.location_type = '分仓'
      THEN MAX(inventory_rows.warehouseid)
    END AS warehouseid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.location_name) AS name_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT inventory_rows.belong_base) AS base_count
  FROM inventory_rows AS inventory_rows
  WHERE
    NOT inventory_rows.pickup_point IS NULL
    AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(inventory_rows.location_code), '') IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    inventory_rows.pickup_point,
    inventory_rows.location_type,
    inventory_rows.location_code
), point_locations AS (
  SELECT
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point AS pickup_point,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_type) AS location_type,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_code) AS location_code,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.location_name) AS location_name,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.belong_base) AS belong_base,
    MAX(point_location_candidates.warehouseid) AS warehouseid
  FROM point_location_candidates AS point_location_candidates
  GROUP BY
    point_location_candidates.pickup_point
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.name_count) = 1
    AND MAX(point_location_candidates.base_count) = 1
), branch_order_lines AS (
 SELECT m.warehouseid AS warehouse_code, m.location_name AS warehouse_name,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(o.executeorderno), '')) AS order_no,
 o.cust_code AS customer_code, o.cust_name AS customer_name,
 o.material_code AS sku, o.material_name AS material_name,
 o.requireddeliverytime AS requested_at, o.header_addtime AS created_at,
 o.qtyordered AS ordered, o.qtyordered AS demand,
 o.qtyallocated AS allocated, o.delivery_qty AS shipped,
 CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.qtyallocated IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN o.qtyordered > o.qtyallocated THEN o.qtyordered-o.qtyallocated ELSE 0 END AS remaining,
 o.bizflowstatus AS order_status,
 CASE WHEN o.qtyordered IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty IS NULL OR o.delivery_qty<o.qtyordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unshipped
 FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d AS o
 INNER JOIN point_locations AS m ON o.pickup_point=m.pickup_point
 WHERE m.location_type='分仓' AND o.detailstatus=10
 AND o.order_close_time IS NULL AND o.wms_close_time IS NULL
 AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.canceltime), '') IS NULL
 AND NULLIF(TRIM(o.cust_order_no), '') IS NOT NULL
 AND (:gea_p1 IS NULL OR m.warehouseid=:gea_p1)
), open_orders AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, l.order_no AS order_no, l.customer_code AS customer_code
 FROM branch_order_lines AS l
 GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.order_no,l.customer_code
 HAVING MAX(l.unshipped)=1
), open_lines AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name,l.order_no AS order_no,
 l.customer_code AS customer_code,l.customer_name AS customer_name,l.sku AS sku,
 l.material_name AS material_name,l.requested_at AS requested_at,l.created_at AS created_at,
 l.ordered AS ordered,l.demand AS demand,l.allocated AS allocated,l.shipped AS shipped,
 l.remaining AS remaining,l.order_status AS order_status,l.unshipped AS unshipped
 FROM branch_order_lines AS l INNER JOIN open_orders AS o
 ON l.warehouse_code=o.warehouse_code AND l.order_no=o.order_no
 AND (l.customer_code=o.customer_code OR (l.customer_code IS NULL AND o.customer_code IS NULL))
), sku_lines AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code,l.order_no AS order_no,l.customer_code AS customer_code,l.sku AS sku,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.material_name)=1 THEN MAX(l.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.ordered)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.ordered) ELSE NULL END AS ordered,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.demand)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.demand) ELSE NULL END AS demand,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.allocated)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.allocated) ELSE NULL END AS allocated,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.shipped)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.shipped) ELSE NULL END AS shipped,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(l.remaining)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(l.remaining) ELSE NULL END AS remaining,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_status)=1 THEN MAX(l.order_status) ELSE NULL END AS order_status
 FROM open_lines AS l WHERE l.order_no=:gea_p2
 AND (l.customer_code=:gea_p3 OR (l.customer_code IS NULL AND :gea_p3 IS NULL))
 GROUP BY l.warehouse_code,l.order_no,l.customer_code,l.sku
), page_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS page_scope_total FROM sku_lines AS l), page_rows AS (
 SELECT l.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, l.order_no AS order_no, l.customer_code AS customer_code, l.sku AS sku, l.material_name AS material_name, l.ordered AS ordered, l.demand AS demand, l.allocated AS allocated, l.shipped AS shipped, l.remaining AS remaining, l.order_status AS order_status,1 AS page_row_present FROM sku_lines AS l
 ORDER BY l.sku LIMIT :gea_p5 OFFSET :gea_p6
)
SELECT p.warehouse_code AS warehouse_code, p.order_no AS order_no, p.customer_code AS customer_code, p.sku AS sku, p.material_name AS material_name, p.ordered AS ordered, p.demand AS demand, p.allocated AS allocated, p.shipped AS shipped, p.remaining AS remaining, p.order_status AS order_status,p.page_row_present AS page_row_present,n.page_scope_total AS page_scope_total
FROM page_count AS n LEFT JOIN page_rows AS p ON TRUE ORDER BY p.sku

/* branch:base-resource-facts */
      WITH latest AS (
        SELECT metric_name, MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date
        FROM data_service.agents_scm_branch_operation_fact
        WHERE metric_group='base_supply' AND metric_name IN ('base_available_qty','base_in_transit_qty')
          AND ((metric_name='base_available_qty' AND source_table='hive.dw.dwd_scm_stock_batch_his')
            OR (metric_name='base_in_transit_qty' AND source_table='hive.dw.dwd_scm_asn_detail')) GROUP BY metric_name
      )
      SELECT BTRIM(f.base_group_name) AS base_name, f.metric_name,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ($1::text = '' OR f.material_code=$1) AND f.metric_value IS NULL) > 0 THEN NULL
          ELSE COALESCE(SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER (WHERE $1::text = '' OR f.material_code=$1),0) END AS quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.material_code) FILTER (WHERE $1::text = '' OR f.material_code=$1) AS sku_count,
        MAX(f.snapshot_date)::text AS source_date
      FROM data_service.agents_scm_branch_operation_fact f
      JOIN latest l ON f.metric_name=l.metric_name AND f.snapshot_date=l.snapshot_date
      WHERE f.metric_group='base_supply' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(f.base_group_name),'') IS NOT NULL
        AND ((f.metric_name='base_available_qty' AND f.source_table='hive.dw.dwd_scm_stock_batch_his')
          OR (f.metric_name='base_in_transit_qty' AND f.source_table='hive.dw.dwd_scm_asn_detail'))
      GROUP BY BTRIM(f.base_group_name), f.metric_name ORDER BY base_name, f.metric_name

/* branch:base-resource-production */
      SELECT BTRIM(p.base_name) AS base_name, CAST(p.base_finish_date AS TEXT) AS day,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(p.planned_qty)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(p.planned_qty) END AS quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.material_code) AS sku_count
      FROM agents_scm_branch_production_plan AS p
      WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(p.base_name),'') IS NOT NULL
        AND p.base_finish_date >= CAST($2 AS DATE)
        AND p.base_finish_date < CAST($2 AS DATE) + 7
        AND (CAST($1 AS TEXT) = '' OR p.material_code=$1)
      GROUP BY BTRIM(p.base_name), p.base_finish_date
      ORDER BY base_name, p.base_finish_date

      SELECT executeorderno, order_status,

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date FROM data_service.agents_scm_branch_inventory_snapshot),

        SELECT i.snapshot_date, i.material_code, i.prod_date,
          MAX(i.material_name) AS material_name, MAX(i.product_categ_name) AS product_categ_name,
          SUM(i.live_qty) AS live_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(i.available_qty)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available_qty, MAX(i.updated_time) AS updated_time
        FROM data_service.agents_scm_branch_inventory_snapshot i
        JOIN latest ON latest.snapshot_date = i.snapshot_date
        WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(i.pickup_point), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(i.self_pickup_point), '')) = $1
        GROUP BY i.snapshot_date, i.material_code, i.prod_date
      )
      SELECT snapshot_date::text AS snapshot_date, material_code, MAX(material_name) AS material_name,
        MAX(product_categ_name) AS product_categ_name, SUM(live_qty) AS live_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(available_qty)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(available_qty) END AS available_qty,
        MAX(updated_time) AS updated_time,
        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 THEN live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS positive_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 AND prod_date IS NOT NULL AND GREATEST(0, snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date) < 30 THEN live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_0_30_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 AND snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date >= 30 AND snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date < 60 THEN live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_30_60_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 AND snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date >= 60 AND snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date < 90 THEN live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_60_90_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 AND prod_date IS NULL THEN live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_age_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 THEN live_qty * GREATEST(0, snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date) ELSE 0 END) AS weighted_age,
        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 AND snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date >= 60 THEN live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS big_date_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 AND snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date >= 90 THEN live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS stagnant_qty,
        MAX(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 THEN GREATEST(0, snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date) ELSE 0 END) AS max_age_days,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE live_qty < 0) AS negative_batch_count
      FROM inventory_batches GROUP BY snapshot_date, material_code ORDER BY material_code

WITH latest AS (
